question: टी20 इतिहास में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के खिलाफ सबसे अधिक बल्लेबाजी औसत किस बल्लेबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
p.player_name, 
SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed,
CASE 
  WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
END AS batting_average
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id 
WHERE pim.team_name = 'Australia' 
AND d.bowling_team != 'Australia'
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;;

question: Across all T20 World Cup editions, which team has used the most bowlers in a single innings and did that strategy result in a win or loss?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    EXTENDED.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
    COUNT(DISTINCT EXTENDED.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used,
    INTENDED.match_result AS match_result
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        D.bowling_team, 
        D.match_id
    FROM Deliveries AS D
    WHERE D.inning = 1
) AS EXTENDED
JOIN
(
    SELECT
        M.team1 AS match_result
    FROM Matches AS M
    WHERE M.season = 'T20 World Cup'
) AS INTENDED ON EXTENDED.match_id = INTENDED.match_id
GROUP BY 
    EXTENDED.bowling_team 
ORDER BY 
    total_bowlers_used DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कप संस्करणों में, एक पारी में सबसे ज़्यादा गेंदबाज़ों का उपयोग किस टीम ने किया और क्या उस रणनीति का परिणाम जीत रहा या हार?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    bowling_team AS "bowling_team",
    MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id)) AS "total_bowlers_used",
    CASE 
        WHEN batting_team = match_winner THEN 'Win'
        ELSE 'Loss'
    END AS "match_result"
FROM
    Deliveries
WHERE 
    season = 'T20 World Cup'
GROUP BY
    bowling_team
ORDER BY
    "total_bowlers_used" DESC;

question: ਸਾਰੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੀ ਉਹ ਰਣਨੀਤੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਜਾਂ ਹਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੀ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamBowlerUsage AS (
    SELECT
        bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE season LIKE 'T20 World Cup%'
    GROUP BY bowling_team
)
SELECT
    bt.bowling_team,
    tbu.total_bowlers_used,
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN 'Win'
            ELSE 'Loss'
        END,
        'NA'
    ) AS match_result
FROM TeamBowlerUsage AS tbu
JOIN Matches AS m ON tbu.bowling_team = m.team2
ORDER BY tbu.total_bowlers_used DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లలో ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బౌలర్లని వాదింది? అప్పుడు వాళ్ళు ఒడిపోయారా లేదా గెలిచారా?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    bt.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.match_winner = bt.bowling_team THEN 'Won'
        ELSE 'Lost'
    END AS match_result
FROM
    Deliveries AS d
INNER JOIN
    Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id
INNER JOIN
    Players AS p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
INNER JOIN
    Matches AS m2 ON d.match_id = m2.match_id
WHERE
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.wides = 0 
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND p.player_name <> 'batting_team'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM FielderDismissals AS fd
        WHERE fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
        AND fd.fielder_id = d.bowler_id
        AND fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
    )
GROUP BY
    bt.bowling_team
ORDER BY
    total_bowlers_used DESC;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कपों में, 17-20 ओवरों में कम-से-कम 100 वैध गेंदें फेंकने वालों में सबसे बेहतरीन इकॉनमी रेट किस गेंदबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name
FROM 
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.bowler_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 2 
    AND d.over_number >= 17 
    AND d.over_number <= 20
    AND d.wides = 0 
    AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.runs_scored > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IS NULL THEN -1
        ELSE SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.runs_scored > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT  o.player_name
FROM Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS o ON pim.match_id = o.match_id AND pim.team_name = o.bowling_team
WHERE p.player_id = o.bowler_id
AND o.inning = 1 
AND o.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
AND o.wides = 0 AND o.noballs = 0
AND o.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY o.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(o.runs_scored / (o.ball_number / 6)) ASC
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.delivery_id) >= 100;

question: ਸਾਰੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 17-20 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਪੜਾਅ ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 100 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹੋਣ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM Players AS p
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  m.season = 'T20 World Cup' AND 
  d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 AND
  d.striker_id != m.toss_winner
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
HAVING
  COUNT(d.delivery_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 
    AVG(d.runs_scored/(d.ball_number/6)) ASC;

question: Who has the best average among bowlers with 10+ wickets, and what is their economy and strike rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    AVG(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS bowling_average,
    (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN d.delivery_id END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM 
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    p.player_id = d.bowler_id
    AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
GROUP BY
    p.player_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN d.delivery_id END) >= 10;

question: అన్నీ T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పులలో ఏ బౌలర్ దగ్గర 17-20 ఓవర్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఎకానమీ రేట్ ఉన్నది? (కనీసం 100 బంతులు విసిరిన)
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
     p.player_name AS player_name
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' 
    AND d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
    AND d.ball_number <= 6
    AND d.bowler_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY  
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    AVG(d.runs_scored / ((d.ball_number +  d.over_number * 6 - 1))) ASC
HAVING 
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) >= 100;

question: 10 या उससे अधिक विकेट लेने वाले गेंदबाज़ों में सबसे बेहतरीन औसत किसका है, और उनकी इकॉनमी तथा स्ट्राइक रेट क्या है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT  
   p.player_name, 
   AVG(d.runs_scored) AS bowling_average, 
   CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS economy_rate, 
   CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS strike_rate 
FROM 
   Players p
JOIN 
   PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id 
JOIN 
   Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
   Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
   d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
   p.player_name
HAVING 
   SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10
ORDER BY 
   bowling_average ASC;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, 10 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਔਸਤ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;

WITH Bowlers AS (
    SELECT 
      p.player_name,
      ROUND(DATEDIFF(match_id, 0) / (COUNT(*) + 0.0), 2) AS `bowling_average`,
      ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) / SUM(DATEDIFF(match_id, 0)), 2) AS `economy_rate`,
      ROUND(SUM(DATEDIFF(match_id, 0)) / SUM(sum(CASE WHEN wicket_type is not NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS `strike_rate`
    FROM Deliveries AS d
    INNER JOIN Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    INNER JOIN Players AS p ON  d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.stage = 'T20I' 
    AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY p.player_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

question: Which fielder has the most dismissals in knockout stage matches, and give dismissals per innings as well?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

    SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) > 0 AND MATCH.inning = 1 THEN SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) ELSE 0 END AS dismissals_per_innings_1,
    CASE WHEN SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) > 0 AND MATCH.inning = 2 THEN SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) ELSE 0 END AS dismissals_per_innings_2

question: 10+ వికెట్లు సంపాదించిన బౌలర్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది? వాళ్ళ ఎకానమీ మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH WicketCounts AS (
    SELECT
        Players.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Deliveries.delivery_id) AS total_deliveries,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Deliveries.wicket_type != 'run out' AND Deliveries.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND Deliveries.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS wickets
    FROM Players 
    JOIN Deliveries ON Players.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
    GROUP BY Players.player_name
), AverageEconomy AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        AVG(CASE WHEN wickets >= 10 THEN Runs / wickets ELSE NULL END) AS bowling_average, 
        AVG(Runs / Over) AS economy_rate 
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Players.player_name,
            SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored) AS Runs,
            COUNT(IF(Deliveries.wicket_type != 'run out' AND Deliveries.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND Deliveries.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field', 1, NULL)) AS wickets
        FROM Players 
        JOIN Deliveries ON Players.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
        GROUP BY Players.player_name
    ) AS RunsAndWickets
    WHERE wickets >= 10
    GROUP BY player_name
)
SELECT 
    player_name, 
    bowling_average, 
    economy_rate, 
    (AVG(total_deliveries) / AVG(wickets)) AS strike_rate
FROM ( SELECT p.player_name, wc.total_deliveries, wc.wickets 
        FROM WicketCounts wc 
        JOIN AverageEconomy AS p 
        ON wc.player_name = p.player_name
    ) AS abc
GROUP BY player_name;

question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;

   p.player_name AS player_name, 
   SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, 
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia') AS times_dismissed, 
   CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia') AS batting_average

question: नॉकआउट चरण के मैचों में सबसे अधिक डिसमिसल किस फील्डर ने किए हैं, और प्रति पारी डिसमिसल भी बताइए?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH Dismissals AS (
    SELECT  
        f.fielder_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM 
        FielderDismissals f
        JOIN Deliveries d ON f.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
        JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        m.stage = 'KnockOut'
    GROUP BY 
        f.fielder_id
),
DismissalsPerInnings AS (

        d.inning,

gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;

WITH MatchWins AS (
    SELECT
        team1 AS team,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN match_id END) AS wins
    FROM Matches
    GROUP BY team1
),
MatchLosses AS (
    SELECT
        team1 AS team,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner != team1 THEN match_id END) AS losses
    FROM Matches

)

gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.runs_scored), 0)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Hetmyer%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Farhan%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Kishan%' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name;

    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_count,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM 
        Players p
    JOIN 
        PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN 
        Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

        pim.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026' AND result_type = 'T20')

        p.player_name
)

    player_name,
    CAST(boundary_count AS REAL) / total_runs * 100 AS boundary_percentage
FROM 
    PlayerRuns;

question: Name the two players who have exactly 4 ducks (0s), played for the same country.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p1.player_name AS player_name,
  p2.player_name AS player_name
FROM Players p1
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON p1.player_id=pim1.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d1 ON pim1.match_id = d1.match_id AND p1.player_id = d1.striker_id
WHERE d1.runs_scored = 0
GROUP BY p1.player_name
HAVING COUNT(d1.delivery_id) = 4
JOIN Players p2 ON p2.player_id = pim1.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON pim2.match_id = pim1.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d2 ON pim2.match_id = d2.match_id AND p2.player_id = d2.striker_id
WHERE d2.runs_scored = 0 
GROUP BY p2.player_name
HAVING COUNT(d2.delivery_id) = 4
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim3 ON p1.player_id = pim3.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim4 ON p2.player_id = pim4.player_id
WHERE pim3.team_name = pim4.team_name;

question: ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਆਊਟ ਕੀਤੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਆਊਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਦਰ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH Dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fielder_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM FielderDismissals f
    JOIN Deliveries d ON f.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY f.fielder_id
),
InnningDismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        f1.fielder_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals_inn1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals_inn2
    FROM Players p
    JOIN FielderDismissals f1 ON p.player_id = f1.fielder_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON f1.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY p.player_name, f1.fielder_id
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    D.total_dismissals,
    (SELECT dismissals_inn1 FROM InnningDismissals WHERE player_name = p.player_name AND fielder_id = D.fielder_id) AS dismissals_per_innings 
FROM Dismissals D
JOIN Players p ON D.fielder_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY  D.total_dismissals DESC;

question: ਉਹ ਦੋ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਠੀਕ 4 ਡੱਕ (0) ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਇੱਕੋ ਦੇਸ਼ ਲਈ ਖੇਡਦੇ ਹਨ।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS player_name,
    p2.player_name AS player_name
FROM Players AS p1
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id
JOIN Players AS p2 ON pim1.player_id != p2.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim2 ON p2.player_id = pim2.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON pim1.match_id = d.match_id AND p1.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    d.wides = 0 
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND pim1.team_name = pim2.team_name
    AND d.ball_number = 0
    AND d.runs_scored = 0
GROUP BY 
    p1.player_name, p2.player_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) = 4;

question: ठीक 3 डक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) किस खिलाड़ी का है, और वह SR क्या है?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  ROUND((CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / (CAST(SUM(d.ball_number) AS REAL)) * 100, 2) ) AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.runs_scored = 3
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name, 
  ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100 / (SUM(d.ball_number)>0 ? SUM(d.ball_number) : 1), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

ORDER BY strike_rate DESC;

    ROUND(SUM(D.runs_scored) * 100 / (COUNT(D.delivery_id) - (SUM(D.wides) + SUM(D.noballs))), 2) AS strike_rate

gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:

    p.player_name, 
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

    p.player_name

LIMIT 1;

question: Among all entries with exactly 19 extras, which team had the highest run rate, and what was their score?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, ((SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(d.extra_runs) = 19 ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

    bt.batting_team AS batting_team,
    (ts.total_score / (SUM(D.over_number) + (SUM(D.ball_number) / 6.0)) ) AS run_rate,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extras) AS total_score
FROM
    Deliveries AS D
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS pm ON D.match_id = pm.match_id AND D.striker_id = pm.player_id
JOIN
    Matches AS ms ON D.match_id = ms.match_id
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS bt ON D.match_id = bt.match_id AND bt.team_name = bt.team_name
WHERE
    D.extras = 19
GROUP BY
    bt.batting_team
ORDER BY
    run_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 800 से अधिक रन और ठीक 3 डक वाले खिलाड़ियों में किसका स्ट्राइक रेट कम है — और कितना कम है?
gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (
    (
      SELECT AVG(d.runs_scored / (d.ball_number + (d.wides + d.noballs))) AS strike_rate
      FROM Deliveries AS d
      WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id
        AND d.inning = 1
        AND d.runs_scored >= 800
        AND d.wides = 0
        AND d.noballs = 0
    )
  )  AS lowest_strike_rate
FROM Players AS p
GROUP BY p.player_id
HAVING COUNT(d.runs_scored) >= 3;

gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;

MIN(ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) / (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) ), 2)) - 1  AS lowest_strike_rate

question: సరిగ్గా 3 డక్కులు మరియు 800 కన్నా ఎక్కువ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? ఆ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(D.runs_scored / (D.ball_number + (D.wides + D.noballs))) ASC) AS lowest_strike_rate
FROM 
  Players AS p
JOIN 
  Deliveries AS D ON p.player_id = D.striker_id
WHERE 
  D.runs_scored >= 800 AND 
  SUM(CASE WHEN D.runs_scored >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
HAVING 
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(D.runs_scored / (D.ball_number + (D.wides + D.noballs))) ASC) = 1;

question: ICC ਮੈਨਜ਼ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਦੌਰਾਨ 19 extra ਰਨ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 68 ਰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਆਊਟ ਹੋਈ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਸੀ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, d.batting_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) = 68 AND SUM(d.extra_runs) = 19;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  b.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
  p.team2 AS opposition
FROM 
  Deliveries d
JOIN 
  Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
  Players p ON m.team2 = p.player_id
JOIN 
  Players b ON d.bowler_id = b.player_id
WHERE 
  m.season = 'ICC T20 Men's World Cup'
  AND d.extra_runs = 19
  AND m.match_winner = p.team2
  AND d.runs_scored  < 68

  );

question: उन दो खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिनके ठीक 4 डक (0) हैं और जो एक ही देश के लिए खेले।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p1.player_name AS player_name, 
  p2.player_name AS player_name
FROM Players AS p1
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d1 ON pim1.match_id = d1.match_id AND p1.player_id = d1.striker_id
JOIN Players AS p2 ON pim1.player_id != p2.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim2 ON pim2.player_id = p2.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d2 ON pim2.match_id = d2.match_id AND p2.player_id = d2.striker_id
WHERE 
  d1.runs_scored = 0 AND d2.runs_scored = 0 
  AND pim1.match_id = pim2.match_id
GROUP BY 
  p1.player_name, p2.player_name
HAVING 
  COUNT(d1.delivery_id) = 4
  AND COUNT(d2.delivery_id) = 4;

question: In the T20 season 2026, which bowler took 4 wickets while conceding just 7 runs, against which opposition, and what was his economy rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) = 7;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  b.player_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.team1 = f.bowling_team THEN m.team2
    ELSE m.team1 
  END AS opposition,
  (SUM(d.runs_scored) / (6 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ) AS economy_rate
FROM
  Players AS p
JOIN 
  Addresses AS a ON p.player_id = a.player_id
JOIN 
  Deliveries AS d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN 
  Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch AS f ON m.match_id = f.match_id AND f.team_name = d.bowling_team
WHERE 
  f.team_name = 'England'
  AND m.season = '2026'
  AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
  AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
  AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
GROUP BY p.player_name,
         CASE 
           WHEN m.team1 = f.bowling_team THEN m.team2
           ELSE m.team1 
         END
HAVING 
  COUNT(*) = 4
ORDER BY p.player_name ASC;

question: T20 ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 7 ਰਨ ਦੇ ਕੇ 4 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲਈਆਂ, ਕਿਸ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼, ਅਤੇ ਉਸਦੀ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਰੇਟ ਕੀ ਸੀ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) = 7;

SELECT 
    P.player_name AS player_name,
    M.team2 AS opposition,
    (CAST(D.runs_scored AS REAL) / CAST(D.over_number AS REAL)) AS economy_rate
FROM 
    Players AS P
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS PIM ON P.player_id = PIM.player_id

    , M.team2
ORDER BY 
    P.player_name;

question: टी20 सीज़न 2026 में, किस गेंदबाज़ ने सिर्फ 7 रन देकर 4 विकेट लिए, किस विपक्ष के खिलाफ, और उनका इकॉनमी रेट क्या था?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) = 7;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.team1 = m.toss_winner THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS opposition,
    ROUND((SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) FROM Deliveries AS d WHERE d.bowler_id = b.player_id AND d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id) / (SELECT COUNT(d.bowler_id) FROM Deliveries AS d WHERE d.bowler_id = b.player_id AND d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')), 2) AS economy_rate

    m.season = '2026' AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')

question: कौन सा भारतीय गेंदबाज़ टी20 सीज़न 2026 की सर्वश्रेष्ठ गेंदबाज़ी आंकड़ों की सूची में 3 या अधिक विकेट लेकर दो बार आया, उसके दोनों विपक्षी कौन थे, और दोनों प्रदर्शनों में कुल कितने विकेट लिए?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowler_id, d.batting_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'India' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3) SELECT player_name, GROUP_CONCAT(opposition, ' and ') AS opponents, SUM(wickets) AS combined_wickets FROM BowlerStats GROUP BY player_name, bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mt.team2) AS opponents,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.bowler_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS combined_wickets
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches mt ON pim.match_id = mt.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON mt.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    mt.season = '2026'  
    AND p.player_name LIKE '%India%'
    AND (
        (d.bowler_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY p.player_id,mt.team2

question: Among players with over 800 runs and exactly 3 ducks, who has the lower strike rate — and by how much?
gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name, 
        ROUND(
            (SUM(d.runs_scored) / (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 END))) * 100, 2
        ) AS strike_rate
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pm.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    WHERE 
        p.player_id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT player_id 
            FROM Deliveries d
            JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
            GROUP BY player_id
            HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3 AND SUM(d.runs_scored) > 800
        )
    GROUP BY player_name 
)
SELECT  
    player_name,
    MIN(strike_rate) AS lowest_strike_rate
FROM PlayerStats
GROUP BY player_name;

gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 20;

gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 World Cup history, which South African fielder has the highest Ct/Inn ratio among all players with 16+ catches,  total catches, and Maximum catches in a single innings?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;

    GROUP BY bowler_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN delivery_id END) AS balls,
        (SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN delivery_id END)) AS economy
    FROM Deliveries
    JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
    WHERE 
        team1 = 'West Indies' OR team2 = 'West Indies' 
        AND season = '2026'
        AND bowling_team <> 'Afghanistan'
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 
    GROUP BY bowler_id
) t2 ON t1.bowler_id = t2.bowler_id
WHERE t1.wickets = 4
AND t2.wickets IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bowler_id
ORDER BY economy_diff DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: टी20 विश्व कप इतिहास में, 16 या उससे अधिक कैच वाले खिलाड़ियों में किस दक्षिण अफ्रीकी फील्डर का Ct/Inn अनुपात सबसे अधिक है, साथ ही कुल कैच और एक पारी में सर्वाधिक कैच भी बताइए?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20SAFields AS (
    SELECT 
        Players.player_name AS fielder,  
        SUM(CASE WHEN FielderDismissals.fielder_id = Players.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_catches,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Deliveries.match_id) AS innings_fielded  
    FROM 
        Players 
    JOIN
        FielderDismissals 
        ON Players.player_id = FielderDismissals.fielder_id
    JOIN 
        Deliveries 
        ON FielderDismissals.delivery_id = Deliveries.delivery_id
    WHERE

)

    innings_fielded, 
    total_catches / innings_fielded AS ct_inn_ratio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN FielderDismissals.fielder_id = Players.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS max_catches_in_inning

HAVING

question: T20 ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ West Indies ਦੇ ਖ��ਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਦੋ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੇ 4-4 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲਈਆਂ — ਦੋਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਵੱਧ ਕਿਫ਼ਾਇਤੀ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਿੰਨਾ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p1.player_name AS bowler1,
    c1.country_name AS country1,
    p2.player_name AS bowler2,
    c2.country_name AS country2,
    CASE 
        WHEN e1.wides + e1.noballs < e2.wides + e2.noballs 
            THEN p1.player_name 
        ELSE p2.player_name
    END AS more_economical,
    (e1.wides + e1.noballs) - (e2.wides + e2.noballs) AS economy_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        p.player_name AS bowler_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as runs_scored,
        SUM(d.wides) + SUM(d.noballs) AS tot_extras,
        COUNT(d.delivery_id) as total_deliveries
    FROM Deliveries AS d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowler_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Players AS p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE 
        pim.team_name != 'West Indies' 
        AND DOES NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FielderDismissals WHERE fielder_dismissal_id = d.delivery_id) 
        AND p.player_name IN (SELECT player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field') 
        AND d.season LIKE '2026' 
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id
) AS e1
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        p.player_name AS bowler_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as runs_scored,
        SUM(d.wides) + SUM(d.noballs) AS tot_extras,
        COUNT(d.delivery_id) as total_deliveries
    FROM Deliveries AS d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowler_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Players AS p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE 
        pim.team_name != 'West Indies'
        AND DOES NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FielderDismissals WHERE fielder_dismissal_id = d.delivery_id)
        AND p.player_name IN (SELECT player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field')   
        AND d.season LIKE '2026'  
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id
) AS e2 ON e1.match_id = e2.match_id
JOIN Players AS p1 ON e1.bowler_name = p1.player_name
JOIN Players AS p2 ON e2.bowler_name = p2.player_name
WHERE 
    (e1.total_deliveries >= 4 AND e2.total_deliveries >= 4)
    AND (e1.runs_scored / e1.total_deliveries) >= 4 
    AND (e2.runs_scored / e2.total_deliveries) >= 4 
    AND e1.runs_scored / e1.total_deliveries > e2.runs_scored / e2.total_deliveries
ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN e1.runs_scored / e1.total_deliveries < e2.runs_scored / e2.total_deliveries THEN 1 
    ELSE 2 END;

question: Among all players with exactly 14 catches, which has the best Ct/Inn ratio, name all four players with 14 catches, their countries, and rank them by Ct/Inn best to worst.
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH CptchCounts AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name,
        p.country,
        COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches
    FROM Players AS p
    INNER JOIN FielderDismissals AS fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, p.country
    HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.country AS country,
    p.total_catches AS total_catches,
    (p.total_catches / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries WHERE striker_id = p.player_id))*100 AS ct_inn_ratio
FROM CptchCounts AS p
ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC 
LIMIT 4;

question: T20 సీజన్ 2026 లో ఏ 2 బౌలర్లు వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నారు? వాళ్ళ పేరులు మరియు దేశాలు రాయండి. ఎవరి ఎకానమీ ఎక్కువ మంచిది? ఎంత తేడాతో?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
  SELECT
    d.bowler_id,
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    p.player_country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.wicket_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wkts
  FROM
    Deliveries d
  JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowler_id = pim.player_id
  JOIN
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
  WHERE
    p.player_country = 'West Indies'
  AND d.match_id IN (
    SELECT
      match_id
    FROM
      Matches
    WHERE
      season = '2026'
  )
  GROUP BY
    d.bowler_id, p.player_name, p.player_country
  HAVING
    wkts >= 4
)

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN p.bowler_name END) AS bowler1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN p.player_country END) AS country1,
  MIN(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN p.bowler_name END) AS bowler2,
  MIN(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN p.player_country END) AS country2,
  MIN(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN p.economy_rate END) AS more_economical,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.wkts = 4 THEN 
    (p.economy_rate - (SELECT AVG(economy_rate) FROM PlayerStats WHERE wkts = 4) )
   ELSE NULL END) AS economy_diff
FROM (
  SELECT
    player_name,
    player_country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (((runs_scored + extra_runs) > 0) AND (deliveries > 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy_rate
  FROM
    (SELECT
      d.bowler_id,
      p.player_name,
      p.player_country,
      COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS deliveries,
      SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs) AS runs_scored
    FROM
      Deliveries d
    LEFT JOIN
      PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowler_id = pim.player_id
    LEFT JOIN
      Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE
      p.player_country = 'West Indies'
    AND d.match_id IN (
      SELECT
        match_id
      FROM
        Matches
      WHERE
        season = '2026'
    )
    GROUP BY
      d.bowler_id, p.player_name, p.player_country) );

gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;

question: సరిగ్గా 14 క్యాచులు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి Ct/Inn రేషియో ఉన్నది? అన్నీ నలుగురు ఆటగాళ్లు మరియు వాళ్ళ దేశాలు రాయండి. వారిని Ct/Inn రేషియో ప్రకారం ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ వరుసలో అమర్చండి.
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
generated_sql:

    p.player_name,
    p.country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fd.fielder_id = p.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_catches,

gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;

        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches
    FROM Players p

    GROUP BY p.player_id 
),CatchesPerInnings AS (

    FROM PlayerCatches pc

    ct_inn_ratio AS ct_inn_ratio

question: Name the West Indian fielder who took 3+ catches in a single match in season 2026, his Ct/Inn ratio, and Maximum catches in an innings.

question: ਉਸ West Indies ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਸਨੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ 3+ ਕੈਚ ਲਏ, ਉਸਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND m.season = '2026')) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mc.match_catches) >= 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.fielder_dismissal_id)
        FROM FielderDismissals AS fd
        WHERE
            fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
            AND MATCH(fd.delivery_id) AGAINST ('*' IN BOOLEAN MODE)
            AND fd.delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 AND season = '2026')
    ) AS ct,
    (
        SELECT
            COUNT(DISTINCT fd.fielder_dismissal_id)
            / COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id)
        FROM FielderDismissals AS fd
        INNER JOIN Deliveries AS d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
        WHERE
            fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
            AND d.season = '2026'
            AND d.inning = 1
    ) AS ct_inn_ratio,
    (
        SELECT MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT fd.fielder_dismissal_id))
        FROM FielderDismissals AS fd
        INNER JOIN Deliveries AS d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
        WHERE
            fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
            AND d.season = '2026'
    ) AS max_catches_in_innings
FROM 
    Players AS p
WHERE
    p.player_name LIKE '%West Indies%'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
ORDER BY
    ct DESC
LIMIT 
    1;

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕੋਈ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਨਾ (NR) ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਲੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਖਰਾਬ ਜਿੱਤ-ਹਾਰ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH TeamSeasonStats AS (SELECT m.season, t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != t.team_name AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr_count FROM Matches m JOIN (SELECT match_id, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT match_id, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches) t ON m.match_id = t.match_id GROUP BY m.season, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, season, wins, losses FROM TeamSeasonStats WHERE nr_count = 0 ORDER BY (wins * 1.0 / (wins + losses)) ASC, losses DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    t.team_name, 
    m.season, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.result_type != 'NR' THEN 1 END) AS wins, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.result_type != 'NR' AND m.match_winner <> t.team_name THEN 1 END) AS losses 
FROM 
    PlayerInMatch AS t
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON t.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
GROUP BY 
    t.team_name, m.season
HAVING 
    t.team_name != m.toss_winner
ORDER BY

gold_sql: WITH TeamSeasonStats AS (SELECT m.season, t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != t.team_name AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr_count FROM Matches m JOIN (SELECT match_id, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT match_id, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches) t ON m.match_id = t.match_id GROUP BY m.season, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, season, wins, losses FROM TeamSeasonStats WHERE nr_count = 0 ORDER BY (wins * 1.0 / (wins + losses)) ASC, losses DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team1 AS team_name,
    m.season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
FROM 
    Matches AS m
LEFT JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND pim.team_name = team1
WHERE 
    m.result_type != 'NR'
GROUP BY 
    team1, m.season
ORDER BY 
    wins ASC, losses ASC;

question: Name the batsmen who scored fastest hundreds against Bangladesh and also report the balls faced by them
gold_sql: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, c.balls_faced FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY c.balls_faced ASC;
gold_answer: ["('DA Miller', 36)", "('Mohammad Haris', 46)", "('SV Samson', 47)", "('C Munro', 54)", "('RR Rossouw', 56)", "('BB McCullum', 58)", "('Ahmed Shehzad', 62)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
p.player_name AS player_name,
(
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
  FROM Deliveries AS d
  WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id
  AND d.match_id IN (
    SELECT m.match_id 
    FROM Matches AS m
    WHERE m.team2 = 'Bangladesh'
  )
) AS balls_faced

ORDER BY balls_faced asc;

  p.player_name, 
  SUM(d.ball_number) AS balls_faced
FROM

question: Which match holds the record for the highest run rate, and what is that run rate?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  team1 AS team1,
  team2 AS team2,
  CAST(SUM(runs_scored) AS REAL) / ( (COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / 6 ) AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries
GROUP BY team1, team2
ORDER BY run_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which team has the highest aggregate losses in the shortest matches (by the balls bowled) without ever winning?
gold_sql: WITH ShortestMatches AS (SELECT match_id FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC LIMIT 15), MatchTeams AS (SELECT m.match_id, m.team1 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id UNION ALL SELECT m.match_id, m.team2 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id) SELECT team, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner != team AND match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aggregate_losses FROM MatchTeams GROUP BY team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY aggregate_losses DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH ShortMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        team1 as team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN player_of_match_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aggregate_losses
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NULL
    GROUP BY team1 
),
ShortMatchesDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.match_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT drv.delivery_id) as balls_bowled
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    JOIN Deliveries drv ON m.match_id = drv.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'team1'
    GROUP BY dm.match_id
),
shortest_matches AS (
    SELECT
        sm.match_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sm.balls_bowled) AS rn
    FROM ShortMatches sm
    JOIN ShortMatchesDeliveries smd ON sm.match_id = smd.match_id
)
SELECT 
    team,
    aggregate_losses 
FROM shortest_matches
ORDER BY aggregate_losses DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 world cup history, which match has the highest ratio of wides to total balls bowled, and what is that ratio?
gold_sql: SELECT batting_team, bowling_team, (SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, batting_team, bowling_team ORDER BY wide_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;

    bt.batting_team AS batting_team,
    bt.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
    SUM(d.wides) * 1.0 / (SUM(d.ball_number) * bt.bowling_team
) AS wide_ratio 
FROM ( 
    SELECT 
        d.batting_team, 
        d.bowling_team 
    FROM Deliveries d 
    WHERE d.innings = 1
        AND d.wides > 0
) bt
GROUP BY bt.batting_team, bt.bowling_team
ORDER BY wide_ratio DESC 
LIMIT 1;

question: ఒక T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ లెగ్ బై పరుగులు సంపాదించింది? లెగ్ బైల సంఖ్య, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, స్థానం, మొత్తం ఎక్స్ట్రా పరుగులు మరియు స్కోర్ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.legbyes) AS total_legbyes, d.bowling_team AS against_whom, m.venue, SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue ORDER BY total_legbyes DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team recorded the most leg byes in a T20I innings, how many , against whom, at what venue, and what were their total extras and score?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.legbyes) AS total_legbyes, d.bowling_team AS against_whom, m.venue, SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue ORDER BY total_legbyes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  d.batting_team AS batting_team,
  SUM(d.legbyes) AS total_legbyes,
  m.team2 AS against_whom,
  m.venue AS venue,
  SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 6 AS total_score
FROM
  Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE  d.inning = 1 AND m.toss_decision = 'field'
GROUP BY d.batting_team
ORDER BY total_legbyes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20I career batting history, which Indian batter has the highest strike rate among all Indian players with 3000+ runs. Report the Strike rate, average, and total sixes?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL), 2) AS average,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
FROM 
    Players AS p
INNER JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
INNER JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pim.team_name = 'India'
    AND p.player_id != ''
    AND p.player_name  LIKE '%India%'
    AND 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    strike_rate DESC;
