question: T20I బ్యాటింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో 3000+ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన భారతీయ క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ఒక మ్యాచ్లో ఆవెరేజ్ పరుగులు మరియు సిక్సుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(((SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100),2) AS strike_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id),2) AS average,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
FROM Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON pm.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE p.player_name !='*' 
AND pm.team_name='India' 
AND p.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Matches WHERE season = 'T20I') 
AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000
order by strike_rate DESC
  limit 1;

question: 29 (50+ ਸਕੋਰ) ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ SR ਹੈ, ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ SR ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player, 
    NULL AS Country,  
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS fifty_plus_scores,
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) / (((SUM(d.runs_scored) AND d.runs_scored > 49) / 6) * (COUNT(d.delivery_id) - ((SUM(d.runs_scored) AND d.runs_scored > 49) / 6))), 2) AS SR 
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE
    d.runs_scored > 49
GROUP BY
    p.player_id, Player   
ORDER BY SR DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 3000 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ Indian ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸ Indian ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ? ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਛੱਕੇ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name                AS player_name,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 AS strike_rate,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS average,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
FROM 
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.Player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pim.team_name = 'India'
    AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000
ORDER BY 
    strike_rate DESC;

question: Among all players with 29 (50+ scores), which has the highest SR, name all four players, their countries, and also give their SR
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS Player,
        p.player_id AS player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fifty_plus_scores,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, p.player_id
)
SELECT 
    Player,
    (
        SELECT country 
        FROM Countries 
        WHERE player_id = PlayerStats.player_id
    ) AS Country,
    fifty_plus_scores,
    CASE 
        WHEN balls_faced > 0 THEN (total_runs / balls_faced) * 100
        ELSE 0
    END AS SR
FROM PlayerStats
WHERE fifty_plus_scores >= 29
ORDER BY SR DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: కనీసం 29 ఇన్నింగ్స్లో 50 లేదా దానికన్నా ఎక్కువ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి క్రీడాకార్లు వాళ్ళ దేశం మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ తో సహ రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS Player,
        country,
        SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fifty_plus_scores,
        ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) / (SUM(ball_number) * 0.1) * 100,2) AS SR
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id AND p.player_id = pm.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, country
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 29
),
RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        Player,
        Country,
        fifty_plus_scores,
        SR,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SR DESC) AS Rank 
    FROM PlayerScores
)
SELECT 
    Player AS Player,
    Country,
    fifty_plus_scores AS fifty_plus_scores,
    SR AS SR
FROM RankedPlayers 
WHERE Rank = 1;

question: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
p.player_name, 
SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes, 
AVG(d.runs_scored) AS average, 
COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_ducks
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = 'T20I') AND d.runs_scored > 50 THEN 1 END) >= 30;

question: टी20I इतिहास में, 30 या उससे अधिक 50+ स्कोर वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस खिलाड़ी ने लगाए हैं, साथ ही उसका औसत और डक भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 6 * (d.runs_scored - (6 * COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 END))) ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes,
  ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 END),2) AS average,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_ducks
FROM 
  Players p
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN 
  Deliveries d ON pm.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
  pm.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'New Zealand', 'England', 'South Africa', 'Pakistan', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Sri Lanka', 'Afghanistan', 'Zimbabwe', 'Kenya', 'Ireland', 'Scotland', 'Netherlands', 'Canada')
  AND d.runs_scored >= 50
  AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
  p.player_id
ORDER BY 
  total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 30;

question: 29 (50+ स्कोर) वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक SR किसका है, सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और उनका SR भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS Player,
  NULL AS Country,  -- Country is not present in the provided schema
  COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS fifty_plus_scores,
  ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (COUNT(d.delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 49 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),2) AS SR
FROM 
  Players p
JOIN
  PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN
  Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
  d.runs_scored >= 50
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
ORDER BY 
  SR DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH ConsecutiveFourWicketHaul AS (
    SELECT
        d1.bowler_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.country,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) as wickets,
        d1.match_id
    FROM
        Deliveries AS d1
    JOIN
        PlayerInMatch AS pim ON d1.match_id = pim.match_id AND d1.bowling_team = pim.team_name
    JOIN
        Players AS p ON d1.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE
        d1.inning = 1
        AND d1.wides = 0
        AND d1.noballs = 0
        AND COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) = 4
    GROUP BY
        d1.match_id, d1.bowler_id
)
GROUP BY bowler_id

question: किस गेंदबाज़ ने लगातार चार-चार विकेट वाले स्पेल लिए, जहाँ दोनों स्पेल पहली पारी में, उसी विपक्ष के खिलाफ, लगातार दिनों में आए? उसका देश, लिए गए विकेट और दिए गए रन का अनुपात, तथा विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH ConsecutiveFourWickets AS (
    SELECT
        b.bowler_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.country,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type <> 'run out' AND d.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS wickets
    FROM  PremierLeague.Deliveries AS d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p
    ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Players AS b
    ON p.player_id = b.player_id
    WHERE
        d.over_number > 1
        AND d.inning = 1
        GROUP BY b.bowler_id
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id)  BETWEEN 2 AND 4
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.country,
    (SELECT bio.country FROM Players bio WHERE bio.player_id = c.bowler_id) AS country, 
    CASE WHEN c.total_runs = 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.wickets / c.total_runs END AS wicket_to_runs_ratio,
    (SELECT team2 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_id = c.match_id) AS opponents 
FROM
    ConsecutiveFourWickets c
    JOIN Players p
    ON c.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY
    p.player_name;

question: ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਲਏ? ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    Players.player_name AS player_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Match_Info.nationality = 'India' THEN 'India'
             WHEN Players.player_nationality = 'Australia' THEN 'Australia'
             ELSE 'Other'
           END) AS country,
    SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT Deliveries.delivery_id) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Matches.team1 = '' THEN Matches.team2
             ELSE Matches.team1
           END) AS opponents
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Players.player_name,
        Players.player_nationality,
        Deliveries.match_id,
        Deliveries.delivery_id
    FROM Players
    JOIN PlayerInMatch on Players.player_id = PlayerInMatch.player_id
    JOIN Matches on PlayerInMatch.match_id = Matches.match_id
    AND MatchInfo.team1 = Players.player_name
    JOIN Deliveries on Deliveries.match_id
        WHERE
            Deliveries.bowling_team = Players.player_name
            AND Deliveries.over_number = 1
            JOIN FielderDismissals on Deliveries.delivery_id = FielderDismissals.delivery_id
            AND FielderDismissals.fielder_id = Players.player_id
            AND Deliveries.wickets > 0
            AND Deliveries.runs = 0
) Match_Info
GROUP BY
    player_name 
ORDER BY
    wicket_to_runs_ratio DESC;

question: ఏ బౌలర్ వరుసగా 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నాడు? రెండు స్పెల్స్ ఒకే టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా వరుస రోజుల్లో మొదటి ఇన్నింగ్స్లో వచ్చాయి. అతన దేశం, వికెట్లు/ఇచ్చిన పరుగుల రేషియో మరియు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
select 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.country,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio,
    t2.team_name AS opponents
from 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch t2 ON m.match_id = t2.match_id AND t2.team_name <> pm.team_name
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.wick_type IS NOT NULL
    AND d.wick_type != 'run out'
    AND d.wick_type != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.wick_type != 'obstructing the field'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, p.country, t2.team_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(d.wick_type) = 4
    AND d.match_id IN (
        SELECT 
            m1.match_id
        FROM 
            Matches m1
        JOIN 
            Matches m2 ON m1.match_id + 1 = m2.match_id
        WHERE 
            m1.season = m2.season
            AND m1.venue = m2.venue
);

question: In T20I career bowling history, which spinner has bowled the most balls despite never taking a five-wicket haul, name his country, wickets, economy?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  m.team1 AS country,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
  CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy
FROM 
  Players AS p
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
  Matches AS m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
  Deliveries AS d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
  d.bowler_id = p.player_id
  AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
  AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
  AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
  AND p.player_name NOT IN ( SELECT player_name FROM ( SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Players AS p1 JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id JOIN Deliveries AS d1 ON pim1.match_id = d1.match_id WHERE d1. bowler_id = p1.player_id AND d1.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d1.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d1.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' GROUP BY player_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 GROUP BY player_name) )
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name, m.team1
ORDER BY 
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC;

question: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸਪਿਨਰ ਨੇ ਕਦੇ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਨਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS economy
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON pm.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND p.bowling_type = 'Spin'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name, p.country
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 5
ORDER BY 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) DESC;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో 30+ యాభై కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఉన్నాయి? అతన ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు డక్కూల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes,
  AVG(d.runs_scored) AS average,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_ducks
FROM
  Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE
  d.inning = 1 AND d.runs_scored <> 0 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0

question: Which team holds the highest ever batting average per wicket in T20I history, name their score, opposition, date and batting average?
gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_runs || '/' || i.wickets_lost AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date, ROUND(CAST(i.total_runs AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN i.wickets_lost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.wickets_lost END, 2) AS batting_average FROM InningsStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    team2 AS team, SUM(runs_scored) AS score,
    team1 AS opposition,
    M.match_date,
    CAST(SUM(runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
FROM
    Deliveries AS D
JOIN
    Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
WHERE
    D.inning = 1
    AND M.stage = 'T20I'
GROUP BY
    team2, team1, M.match_date
ORDER BY
    batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_runs || '/' || i.wickets_lost AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date, ROUND(CAST(i.total_runs AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN i.wickets_lost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.wickets_lost END, 2) AS batting_average FROM InningsStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.team_name AS team,
    SUM(b.runs_scored) AS score,
    OP.team_name AS opposition,
    m.match_date,
    CAST(SUM(b.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT wi.player_out_id) AS batting_average
FROM 
    PlayerInMatch b
JOIN 
    Matches m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON b.player_id = d.striker_id

    Matches OP ON m.match_id = OP.match_id AND OP.team1 != m.team1

    d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0

GROUP BY 
    b.team_name, OP.team_name, m.match_date
ORDER BY 
    batting_average DESC;

question: Which team achieved the highest average per wicket in fewer than 9 overs in T20I history. Give the name of the team, average, overs, opposition, and date?

    SUM(over_number + (ball_number / 10.0)) AS overs,

question: T20I ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਗੁਆਈਆਂ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS batting_team, 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score,
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) ) / (SUM(d.ball_number)) AS run_rate,
    d.bowling_team AS opposition,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN PlayerInMatch pi ON d.match_id = pi.match_id AND d.batting_team = pi.team_name
GROUP BY d.batting_team, d.bowling_team
HAVING d.inning = 2
ORDER BY run_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో 2 టీములు సరిగ్గా 10 పరుగులలో అల్ అవుట్ అయ్యారు. టీముల పేరులు, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీములు, ఓవర్ల సంఖ్య మరియు ఇన్నింగ్ సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opponents, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, d.inning AS innings_number FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 10;

question: In T20I history, which team scored just 12 runs , the third lowest total ever ,name their opposition, overs faced?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 12;

    m.team1 AS batting_team,
    m.team2 AS opposition,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(d.delivery_id)
        FROM Deliveries AS d
        WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.runs_scored > 0

question: 14 POTM अवॉर्ड वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में किसका अवॉर्ड-प्रति-मैच अनुपात सबसे अच्छा है — सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, खेले गए मैच, और प्रत्येक का अनुपात बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT 
      p.player_name AS player_name,
      COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches_played,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(m.match_id) = 0 THEN 
           0 
         ELSE

FROM Players p
INNER JOIN Matches m ON p.player_id = m.player_of_match_id
GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(m.match_id) > 0

question: Among all players with 14 POTM awards, which has the best award-to-match ratio — name all four players, their matches played, and calculate ratio for each
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_of_match_id 
        FROM Matches
        GROUP BY player_of_match_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) = 14
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),

PlayerAwards AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id, 
        COUNT(match_id) AS total_awards
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_of_match_id 
        FROM Matches
        GROUP BY player_of_match_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) = 14
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
)

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pm.matches_played,
    p.total_awards / pm.matches_played AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM Players p 
JOIN PlayerMatches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN PlayerAwards pa ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
WHERE pa.total_awards = 14
ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: China suffered back-to-back extremely low T20I totals against different opponents on consecutive days at the same venue. Give both scores, opponents, venue, and dates?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS scores, d.bowling_team AS opponents, m.venue, m.match_date AS dates FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'China' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY scores ASC LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(8, 'Thailand', 'Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok, Hong Kong', '2024-12-07')", "(23, 'Malaysia', 'Bayuemas Oval, Kuala Lumpur', '2023-07-26')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    g1.result_margin AS scores,
    CONCAT(g1.team1, ' vs ', g1.team2) AS opponents,
    g1.venue AS venue,
    g1.match_date AS dates
FROM 
    Matches AS g1
JOIN 
    Matches AS g2 ON g1.venue = g2.venue AND g1.match_date < g2.match_date AND g1.match_id < g2.match_id

    g1.result_margin < 100 AND g2.result_margin < 100

question: ਚੀਨ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕੋ ਮੈਦਾਨ 'ਤੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਵਿਰੋਧੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਬੈਕ-ਟੂ-ਬੈਕ ਬਹੁਤ ਘੱਟ T20I ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਪਿਆ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS scores, d.bowling_team AS opponents, m.venue, m.match_date AS dates FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'China' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY scores ASC LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(8, 'Thailand', 'Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok, Hong Kong', '2024-12-07')", "(23, 'Malaysia', 'Bayuemas Oval, Kuala Lumpur', '2023-07-26')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('S1', S1, 'S2', S2)) as scores,
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('T1', T1, 'T2', T2)) as opponents,
    Venue, 
    Dates
FROM (
    SELECT   
        MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN D2.runs_scored ELSE NULL END) AS S1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN D2.runs_scored ELSE NULL END) AS S2,
        M.venue AS Venue,
        M.match_date AS Dates,
        M.team1 AS T1,
        M.team2 AS T2
    FROM Deliveries AS D1
    JOIN Deliveries AS D2 ON D1.match_id = D2.match_id
    JOIN Matches AS M ON D1.match_id = M.match_id 
    WHERE D1.inning = 1 AND D2.inning = 2
    AND (
        D1.match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = 'china' GROUP BY match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2)  
        OR D2.match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = 'china' GROUP BY match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2)
    )
    GROUP BY M.match_id, M.venue, M.match_date, M.team1, M.team2
    HAVING S1 IS NOT NULL AND S2 IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery
GROUP BY Venue, Dates;

question: 14 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య/మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య రేషియో ఉన్నది? క్రీడాకార్ల పేరు, మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య మరియు రేషియోలు రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  COUNT(m1.match_id) AS matches_played,
  CAST(COUNT(m1.match_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m1.match_id) AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM Players AS p
JOIN Matches AS m1 ON p.player_id = m1.player_of_match_id
GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.match_id) = 14
ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC;

question: V Kohli మరియు RG Sharma దగ్గర 14+ 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు ఉన్నాయి. వాళ్ళ అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య, మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య, ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు మరియు అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య/మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య రేషియోలు రాయబడి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT  
    p.player_name AS player_name, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id THEN 1 END) AS potm_awards, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches_played, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', m.match_date, 'start of year') AS span,
    CAST(potm_awards AS REAL) / matches_played AS award_to_match_ratio  
FROM Players p
JOIN Matches m ON p.player_id = m.player_of_match_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma')
GROUP BY p.player_name, span
ORDER BY span;

question: वी कोहली और आरजी शर्मा दोनों के पास 14 या उससे अधिक POTM अवॉर्ड हैं। उनके अवॉर्ड, मैच, करियर स्पैन, और अवॉर्ड-प्रति-मैच अनुपात बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS potm_awards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id) AS matches_played,
    (
        SELECT 
            MAX(m.match_date) - MIN(m.match_date)
        FROM 
            Matches m
        WHERE
            m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id
    ) AS span,
    CASE 
        WHEN matches_played = 0 THEN 
            0
        ELSE 
            CAST(potm_awards AS REAL) / matches_played 
    END AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM 
    Players p
WHERE 
    p.player_name IN('V Kohli', 'R. Sharma')
    AND p.player_id IN(SELECT DISTINCT player_of_match_id FROM Matches)
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
HAVING 
    potm_awards >= 14
ORDER BY 
    p.player_name;

question: Virat Kohli ਅਤੇ RG Sharma ਦੋਵਾਂ ਕੋਲ 14 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ POTM ਅਵਾਰਡ ਹਨ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਵਾਰਡ, ਮੈਚ, ਸਮਾਂ-ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਅਵਾਰਡ-ਤੋਂ-ਮੈਚ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਦੱਸੋ?

    P.player_name AS player_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) AS potm_awards, 
    COUNT(M.match_id) AS matches_played,

    COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT  M.match_id) AS award_to_match_ratio

question: टी20I इतिहास में सबसे कम मैचों में 8 POTM अवॉर्ड जीतने वाला खिलाड़ी कौन है — उसका देश, करियर स्पैन और अवॉर्ड अनुपात बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.player_name,
    MAX(match_id) - MIN(match_id) + 1 AS span, 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT mm.match_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS award_ratio
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pi ON p.player_id = pi.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches mm ON pi.match_id = mm.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON mm.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    mm.season = 'T20I'
AND 
    d.inning = 1
AND 
    d.wides = 0
AND 
    d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name 
ORDER BY 
    award_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ క్రీడాకారుడు అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ మ్యాచులలో 8 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు గెలిచాడు? అతన దేశం, ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు మరియు రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT PlayerInMatch.player_name AS player_name,
       Players.player_country AS country,
       STRFTIME('%Y', Matches.match_date, 'start_date') AS span,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Matches.player_of_match_id = Players.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Matches.match_id) AS award_ratio
FROM Players
JOIN PlayerInMatch ON Players.player_id = PlayerInMatch.player_id
JOIN Matches ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE Matches.result_type = 'win'
     AND Players.player_country IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY PlayerInMatch.player_name, Players.player_country, STRFTIME('%Y', Matches.match_date)
ORDER BY award_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: V Kohli and RG Sharma both have 14+ POTM awards. Give their awards, matches, spans, and award-to-match ratios
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS potm_awards,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') THEN m.match_id END) AS matches_played,
    MIN(m.match_date) AS span_start,
    MAX(m.match_date) AS span_end
FROM
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.player_of_match_id
WHERE 
    p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma')
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name,
    m.match_id
ORDER BY 
    p.player_name, MIN(m.match_date);

    CAST(potm_awards AS REAL) / total_matches AS award_ratio
FROM PlayerStats
WHERE potm_awards = 8
ORDER BY
    award_ratio DESC
    LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerAwards AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        p.player_id,
        GROUP_CONCAT(m.season ORDER BY m.season SEPARATOR ' - ') AS span,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) AS award_count
    FROM 
        Players p
    JOIN 
        PlayerInMatch mi ON p.player_id = mi.player_id
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON mi.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        m.result_type <> 'abandoned'
    AND mi.team_name <> 'England Ladies'
    AND m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) = 8
),
PlayerCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN w.wicket_type IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS bowler_wickets
    FROM 
        Players p
    LEFT JOIN 
        PlayerInMatch mi USING (player_id)
    LEFT JOIN 
        Matches m USING (match_id)
    LEFT JOIN 
        Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        FielderDismissals w USING (delivery_id)
    WHERE 
        w.fielder_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY 
        player_name, player_id
),

RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        paw.player_name,
        paw.span,
        paw.award_count,
        (paw.award_count / pct.total_matches) AS award_ratio
    FROM 
        PlayerAwards paw
    JOIN
        (
            SELECT 
                p.player_name,
                COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) AS total_matches
            FROM 
                Players p
            JOIN 
                PlayerInMatch mi ON p.player_id = mi.player_id
            GROUP BY 
                p.player_name
        ) AS pct ON paw.player_name = pct.player_name
)
SELECT
    player_name,
    country,
    span,
    award_ratio
FROM
    RankedPlayers
ORDER BY
    award_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Name the top three Pakistani Bowlers who have fastest-to-50 wickets. Rank them by days taken fastest to slowest?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY days_taken ASC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
WITH PakistaniBowlers AS (
SELECT
    p.player_name,

JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches ON pim.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE
  p.player_name LIKE '%Pakistan%'
  AND p.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
  AND Deliveries.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
  AND Matches.team1 = 'Pakistan'
  OR Matches.team2 = 'Pakistan'
GROUP BY p.player_name
),

WicketCounts AS (
  SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS wickets
  FROM PakistaniBowlers p
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_name = (
    SELECT bowler_name
    FROM PakistaniBowlers
    WHERE player_name = p.player_name
  )
  GROUP BY bowler_name
),

DaysTo50 AS (

    (
      SELECT
        julianday(Matches.match_date)

question: वाईएम नकान्या ने सबसे कम कैलेंडर समय में 50 विकेट लिए। सटीक दिनों की गणना कीजिए, उसका देश, मैच, और उपलब्धि की तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'YM Nkanya' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS exact_days, m.country, m.match_number AS matches, m.match_date AS achievement_date FROM Milestone m WHERE m.rn = 1;
generated_sql:
WITH WicketCount AS (
  SELECT
    player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type <> 'run out' AND wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    country,
    CreatedAt
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  JOIN Deliveries ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Deliveries.match_id AND PlayerInMatch.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
  GROUP BY player_id, country, CreatedAt
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type <> 'run out' AND wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 50
),
RankedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    CASE WHEN
      min(CreatedAt) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      min(CreatedAt)
    END AS min_achievement
  FROM WicketCount
  GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN player_id = 'WYMatikan' THEN DATEDIFF(day, min_achievement, CreatedAt) / 1 ELSE NULL END) AS exact_days,
  country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PlayerInMatch.match_id) AS matches,
  min_achievement AS achievement_date
FROM PlayerInMatch
JOIN Deliveries ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Deliveries.match_id AND PlayerInMatch.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
JOIN RankedWickets ON PlayerInMatch.player_id = RankedWickets.player_id
WHERE
  PlayerInMatch.player_id = 'WYMatikan' AND Deliveries.inning = 1 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
GROUP BY
  country, 
  DatedIFF(day, min_achievement, CreatedAt)

gold_sql: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;

question: YM Nkanya took 50 wickets in the shortest calendar time. Calculate the exact days, name his country, matches, and achievement date?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'YM Nkanya' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS exact_days, m.country, m.match_number AS matches, m.match_date AS achievement_date FROM Milestone m WHERE m.rn = 1;
generated_sql:
WITH WicketCount AS (
    SELECT 
        player_of_match_id as player_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', match_date) AS achievement_date,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS wickets
    FROM Matches
    JOIN PlayerInMatch ON Matches.match_id = PlayerInMatch.match_id
    JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
    WHERE Deliveries.bowler_id = PlayerInMatch.player_id
    GROUP BY player_of_match_id, achievement_date
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) = 50
),

FastestWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', achievement_date) AS achievement_date,
        strftime('%Y', achievement_date) AS year,
        SUM(JULIANDAY(achievement_date) - JULIANDAY('2000-01-01'))
    AS exact_days
    FROM WicketCount
    GROUP BY player_id, achievement_date, year
)
SELECT 
    MIN(exact_days) AS exact_days,
    (
        SELECT 
            player_name
        FROM Players
        WHERE player_id = FastestWickets.player_id
    ) AS country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FastestWickets.player_id) AS matches,
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', achievement_date) AS achievement_date
FROM FastestWickets
GROUP BY exact_days, achievement_date
ORDER BY exact_days ASC;

question: Australia ਨੇ 3 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 197/7 ਬਣਾਏ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਜਿੱਤਿਆ। ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਸਨ?

gold_sql: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;

question: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS REAL) AS strike_rate,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS hundreds,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS average,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS balls_per_hundred
    FROM Players p
    INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    INNER JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id
) 

SELECT 
    player_name,
    strike_rate,
    hundreds,
    average,
    balls_per_hundred
FROM PlayerStats
WHERE player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma'
ORDER BY player_name;

question: Which match had the highest number of no-balls ever recorded in a T20I? Name the teams, ground, date, and calculate what percentage of total extras in that match were no-balls alone.
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;

    m.team1 AS team1,
    m.team2 AS team2,
    m.venue AS ground,
    m.match_date AS date,
    SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id

question: New Zealand vs West Indies at Auckland (T20I #1108) ended in 31.2 overs with 359 combined team runs . Calculate the runs scored from non-extras and extras as a percentage of total team runs
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਹੋਏ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁੱਲ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨੋ ਬਾਲ ਸਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    team1,
    team2,
    venue,
    match_date,
    SUM(noballs) AS total_noballs,
    ROUND((SUM(noballs) * 100.0 / (SUM(noballs) + SUM(wides) + SUM(byes) + SUM(legbyes))) , 2) AS noball_percentage
FROM
    Deliveries AS D
JOIN
    Matches AS M
ON
    D.match_id = M.match_id
WHERE
    M.season = 'T20I'
GROUP BY
    team1,
    team2,
    venue,
    match_date
ORDER BY
    total_noballs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: किस टी20I मैच में अब तक सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल दर्ज की गईं? टीमों के नाम, मैदान, तारीख, और उस मैच के कुल एक्स्ट्रा में से केवल नो-बॉल का प्रतिशत बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  team1, 
  team2,
  venue,
  match_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_noballs,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / (SUM(noballs) +SUM(wides) + SUM(byes) + SUM(legbyes)) AS noball_percentage
FROM Matches 
JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
WHERE 
  toss_decision = 'field' AND season = 'T20I'
  GROUP BY 
   team1, team2, venue, match_date
ORDER BY total_noballs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਓਵਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 3 T20I ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || d.inning || d.over_number))) AS nb_per_over_ratio FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  team1,
  team2,
  SUM(noballs) * 6 / COUNT(DISTINCT over_number) AS nb_per_over_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS team1,
    d.bowling_team AS team2,
    d.noballs
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.format = 'T20I'
    AND d.noballs > 0
)
GROUP BY team1, team2
ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

question: टी20I इतिहास के शीर्ष 5 रन-स्कोररों के लिए स्ट्राइक रेट, प्रति पारी औसत रन बताइए, और उन्हें बल्लेबाजी औसत के आधार पर रैंक कीजिए।
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name, 
        ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate,
        ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN d.delivery_id ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_runs_per_innings,
        ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS batting_average
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'team1' OR pim.team_name = 'team2'
    GROUP BY p.player_name
)

ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਲਈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਦੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਦੱਸੋ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਦਰਜਾਬੰਦੀ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(d.ball_number) AS REAL)) * 100 AS strike_rate,
  CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS avg_runs_per_innings, 
  CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type  != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS batting_average
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
  d.inning = 1
  AND d.bowler_id != d.player_out_id 
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: List the top 3 matches with the highest no-balls per over ratio. Name both the teams and give the corresponding ratio as well.
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || d.inning || d.over_number))) AS nb_per_over_ratio FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
WITH NoeBowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (COUNT(d.over_number) / 6), 2) as nb_per_over_ratio
    FROM 
        Matches m
    JOIN 
        Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    GROUP BY 
        m.team1, m.team2
)
SELECT 
    team1, 
    team2, 
    nb_per_over_ratio
FROM 
    NoeBowlers
ORDER BY 
    nb_per_over_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.
gold_sql: WITH Catches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id), InningsPlayed AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_innings FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_catches * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.total_innings, 0)) AS catches_per_innings_ratio FROM Catches c JOIN InningsPlayed i ON c.fielder_id = i.player_id JOIN Players p ON c.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY catches_per_innings_ratio DESC LIMIT 5;

  p.player_name,
  (

gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

        ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT pm.player_id), 2) AS batting_average

gold_sql: SELECT p_striker.player_name AS batter, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 || ' on ' || m.match_date AS match FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date ORDER BY runs_scored DESC LIMIT 1;

    Players.player_name AS batter,
    MAX(Deliveries.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
    Players.player_name AS bowler,
    Matches.match_id AS match

    Deliveries
JOIN 
    Players ON Deliveries.bowler_id = Players.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id

generated_sql:
SELECT  p1.player_name AS player, 
        SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS runs, 
        p2.player_name AS bowler, 
        m.match_id AS match, 
        m.venue AS venue, 
        m.match_date AS match_date
FROM  Players AS p1
JOIN Deliveries AS d1 ON p1.player_id = d1.striker_id
JOIN Players AS p2 ON p2.player_id = d1.bowler_id
JOIN Matches AS m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d1.over_number IN (SELECT over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 GROUP BY over_number HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
AND d1.ball_number = 6
AND d1.runs_scored > 20
AND d1.wicket_type <> 'run out'
AND d1.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt'
AND d1.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field'
AND d1.wides = 0
AND d1.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p1.player_id, p2.player_id, m.match_id, m.venue, m.match_date
ORDER BY runs DESC;

question: गेंदों के आधार पर टी20I इतिहास की सबसे छोटी पूर्ण पारी कौन-सी है? टीम, स्कोर, गेंदें, रन रेट और विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    t1.team_name AS team, 
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS score, 
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS balls, 
    CAST(MAX(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS run_rate,
    t2.team_name AS opposition
FROM 
    PlayerInMatch AS t1
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON t1.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON t1.match_id = d.match_id AND t1.team_name = d.bowling_team
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS t2 ON m.match_id = t2.match_id AND t1.match_id <> t2.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'T20I' 
    AND d.inning = 1

question: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) as player_runs,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS team_total,
    (SUM(D.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(D.runs_scored)) AS percentage_of_team_total
FROM
    Players p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN
    Deliveries D ON m.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE
    m.season = 'T20' AND 
    D.inning = 1 AND
    p.player_id = D.striker_id AND
    D.wicket_type IS NULL
GROUP BY
