gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS player_runs,
    Mi.team_total,
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) / Mi.team_total) * 100 AS percentage_of_team_total
FROM
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch Mi ON p.player_id = Mi.player_id
JOIN
    Deliveries d ON Mi.match_id = d.match_id 
AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE
    d.inning = 1 
    AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY
    p.player_name, Mi.team_total
ORDER BY
    Mi.team_total;

question: Shivam Dube scored consecutive fifties in 2 T20I innings. List both innings with runs, team name, opposition, and venue
gold_sql: WITH PlayerAllInnings AS (SELECT p.player_name, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, d.batting_team AS team_name, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.match_date) AS inning_seq FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name = 'S Dube' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.match_id, m.match_date, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue), FiftyInnings AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_date) AS fifty_seq FROM PlayerAllInnings WHERE runs >= 50), StreakGroups AS (SELECT *, (inning_seq - fifty_seq) AS streak_id FROM FiftyInnings), ValidStreaks AS (SELECT streak_id FROM StreakGroups GROUP BY streak_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT sg.player_name, sg.runs, sg.team_name, sg.opposition, sg.venue FROM StreakGroups sg JOIN ValidStreaks vs ON sg.streak_id = vs.streak_id ORDER BY sg.match_date LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: [['CG Williams', 81, 'Namibia', 'Uganda', 'Windhoek'], ['CG Williams', 57, 'Namibia', 'U.A.E.', 'ICCA Dubai'], ['CG Williams', 50, 'Namibia', 'Scotland', 'ICCA Dubai'], ['CG Williams', 57, 'Namibia', 'P.N.G.', 'ICCA Dubai']]

WITH Fifties AS (
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) as runs,
    team_name,
    CASE
        WHEN p2.player_id IS NULL THEN 'NA'
        ELSE p2.player_name
    END AS opposition,
    m.venue
FROM
    Players p
JOIN Delivery AS d
    ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches AS m
    ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pi
    ON m.match_id = pi.match_id AND p.player_id = pi.player_id
LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p2
    ON m.match_id = p2.match_id AND m.team2 = p2.team_name
WHERE
    p.player_id = 'Shivam Dube'
  AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY
    p.player_name, m.match_id, team_name, m.venue
   HAVING
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    m.match_id) 
SELECT 
    player_name AS player_name,
    runs AS runs,
    team_name AS team_name,
    opposition AS opposition,
    venue AS venue 
FROM Fifties 
ORDER BY 
    m.match_id;

question: T20Iలలో ఒకే ఓవర్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన రికార్డులలో, అదే ఓవర్‌లో వికెట్ కూడా పడిన సందర్భాలు ఏవి? ఆటగాడు, పరుగులు, బౌలర్, మ్యాచ్, వేదిక మరియు తేదీని తెలపండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs, p2.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p.player_name, p2.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5;

question: करियर इतिहास में सबसे अधिक टी20I मैच किसने खेले हैं? उनके मैचों की संख्या, रन, विकेट और करियर स्पैन बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), RunStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), WicketStats AS (SELECT bowler_id AS player_id, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wickets FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired not out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY bowler_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches, COALESCE(rs.runs, 0) AS runs, COALESCE(ws.wickets, 0) AS wickets, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN RunStats rs ON ms.player_id = rs.player_id LEFT JOIN WicketStats ws ON ms.player_id = ws.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    STRFTIME('%Y', MIN(M.match_date)) || '-' || STRFTIME('%Y', MAX(M.match_date)) AS span
FROM Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS Pim ON p.player_id = Pim.player_id
JOIN Matches AS M ON Pim.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON M.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE M.stage = 'T20I'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    matches DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

question: పూర్తయిన ఒక T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో చివరి వరకు బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన ప్రతి ఆటగాడి పరుగులను, జట్టు మొత్తం పరుగులలో శాతంగా లెక్కించండి
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

  p.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS player_runs,
  SUM(d2.runs_scored) AS team_total,

FROM
  Players p

JOIN

question: Which player holds the highest batting average in T20I career among players who have played 100 or more T20I matches? Give number of matches, runs, average, and span.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 100), BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), DismissalStats AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches_played AS matches, COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS runs, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ds.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) AS average, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN BattingStats bs ON ms.player_id = bs.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissalStats ds ON ms.player_id = ds.player_id ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Who has played the most T20I matches in career history? Give their number of matches, runs, wickets, and span.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), RunStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), WicketStats AS (SELECT bowler_id AS player_id, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wickets FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired not out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY bowler_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches, COALESCE(rs.runs, 0) AS runs, COALESCE(ws.wickets, 0) AS wickets, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN RunStats rs ON ms.player_id = rs.player_id LEFT JOIN WicketStats ws ON ms.player_id = ws.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches DESC LIMIT 1;

    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,

question: हारने वाली टीम की दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी करते हुए सबसे अधिक रन किस खिलाड़ी ने बनाए, और उसका स्कोर पूरे तालिका में हारने वाली टीम के सर्वाधिक व्यक्तिगत स्कोर से कितना कम या ज़्यादा था?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;

    p.player_name,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS two_innings_losing_total,
    MAX(p.runs_scored) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) - MAX(p.runs_scored) AS difference 
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id

question: Which player scored the highest runs on the losing side while batting in 2 innings, and what was the difference between their score and the highest single-innings losing score in the entire table?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    (
        SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) 
        FROM Deliveries d
        JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
        WHERE pim.match_id = m.match_id
        AND d.batting_team = m.team2
        AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
        GROUP BY p.player_id
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.inning) = 2
    ) AS two_innings_losing_total,
(
    SELECT MAX(d.runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND d.batting_team = m.team2
    GROUP BY m.match_id
) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
(
    SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND d.batting_team = m.team2
    AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.inning) = 2
    ) - (SELECT MAX(d.runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND d.batting_team = m.team2
    GROUP BY m.match_id
) AS difference
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id 
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY two_innings_losing_total DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਕਿਸ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਟੇਬਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਿੰਗਲ ਪਾਰੀ ਸਕੋਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸੀ?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
p.player_name, 
SUM(d.runs_scored) AS two_innings_losing_total,
MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN SUM(d.runs_scored) ELSE 0 END) AS highest_single_innings_losing,

question: पूर्ण टी20I पारी में कैरी द बैट करते हुए सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत स्कोर किस खिलाड़ी का है? रन, टीम का कुल स्कोर, विपक्षी टीम और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, MAX(d.runs_scored) AS runs, 
       SUM(d.runs_scored) AS team_total,
       m.team2 AS opposition,
       m.match_date
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id
AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE m.stage = 'T20I'
AND d.inning = 1
AND d.wides = 0
AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.team2, m.match_date
ORDER BY team_total DESC;

question: ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు తరఫున 2 ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసి అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు, మరియు వారి స్కోరుకు, మొత్తం పట్టికలో ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు చేసిన అత్యధిక స్కోరుకు మధ్య ఉన్న తేడా ఎంత?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;
generated_sql:
WITH HighestLosingScore AS (
    SELECT
        team2 AS losing_team,
        MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) ELSE 0 END) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) ELSE 0 END) AS second_highest_single_innings_losing
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE bowling_team = 'team1'
        AND (wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
        OR wicket_type IS NULL)
    GROUP BY team2
)

SELECT 
    PI.player_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
                WHEN  del.inning = 1 THEN del.runs_scored + del.extra_runs 
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
                WHEN del.inning = 2 THEN del.runs_scored + del.extra_runs 
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) AS two_innings_losing_total,
    MAX(CASE 
                WHEN del.inning = 1 THEN del.runs_scored + del.extra_runs 
                ELSE 0
            END) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
                WHEN  del.inning = 1 THEN del.runs_scored + del.extra_runs 
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
                WHEN del.inning = 2 THEN del.runs_scored + del.extra_runs 
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) - 
            ( 
                SELECT 
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN runs_scored + extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) + 
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN runs_scored + extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) 
                FROM HighestLosingScore 
            ) AS difference
FROM Players AS PI
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS Pim ON PI.player_id = Pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS del ON Pim.match_id = del.match_id
GROUP BY PI.player_name
ORDER BY two_innings_losing_total DESC;	));

question: How many players scored exactly 110 runs on the losing side, and how many of them batted in 2 innings?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Players p
   JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
   JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
   JOIN Deliveries d ON pm.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
   WHERE m.match_winner != pm.team_name AND d.runs_scored = 110) as players_with_110_runs,

question: 100 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ T20I ਮੈਚ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ? ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਰਨ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ-ਕਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 100), BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), DismissalStats AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches_played AS matches, COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS runs, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ds.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) AS average, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN BattingStats bs ON ms.player_id = bs.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissalStats ds ON ms.player_id = ds.player_id ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id),2) AS average,
    (
    SELECT MAX(m.match_date)
    FROM Matches AS m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id
    ) AS span
FROM Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE d.inning = 1
GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) >= 100
ORDER BY average DESC;

question: In T20Is, which team posted the highest score despite having 4 or more batsmen run out in a single innings and still lost the match? Return the team, score, opposition.
gold_sql: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  d.batting_team AS team,
  MAX(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs)) AS score,
  m.team2 AS opposition
FROM 
  Deliveries d
JOIN 
  Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
  m.season = 'T20I'
  AND d.inning = 1
  AND d.wickets_taken LIKE '%run out%'
  GROUP BY 
  d.batting_team
  HAVING 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type LIKE '%run out%' THEN 1 END) >= 4
ORDER BY 
  score DESC;

gold_sql: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: ਕਿਸ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ ਪੂਰੀ T20I ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਟ ਆਊਟ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ? ਰਨ, ਟੀਮ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    MAX(m.result_margin) AS team_total,
    m.team2 AS opposition,
    m.match_date AS match_date
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1
    AND d.wicket_type IS NULL
    AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, m.team2, m.match_date
ORDER BY 
    runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, which match holds the record for the highest match aggregate, and what was the run rate of that match?
gold_sql: WITH MatchAggregates AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date, ma.total_runs AS match_aggregate, ROUND(ma.total_runs * 6.0 / ma.legal_balls, 2) AS run_rate FROM MatchAggregates ma JOIN Matches m ON ma.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY ma.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team1 AS team1,
    team2 AS team2,
    match_date AS match_date,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS match_aggregate,
    CAST(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS REAL) / ((SELECT STRFTIME('%s', match_date) - STRFTIME('%s', MIN(match_date)))/3600*60 WHERE delivery_id.match_id = Matches.match_id GROUP BY match_id) AS run_rate
FROM 
    Matches
JOIN 
    Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
WHERE 
    season = 'T20I' AND delivery_id.wides = 0 AND delivery_id.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    team1, team2, match_date
ORDER BY match_aggregate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    d.bowler_id AS bowler,
    d.striker_id AS batter,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS dismissals,
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THENstriker_id END))*1.0,2) AS batting_average
FROM
    Deliveries d
LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
WHERE 
  pim.team_name = 'Team'
  AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY
    d.bowler_id, d.striker_id
HAVING 
  COUNT (CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) > 0   
ORDER BY
    dismissals DESC;

question: T20Iలలో, ఏ బౌలర్ ఇద్దరు వేర్వేరు బ్యాటర్లను ఒక్కొక్కరిని 5 లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ సార్లు అవుట్ చేశాడు? ఆ బౌలర్, ఆ ఇద్దరు బ్యాటర్లు మరియు వారి వారి వికెట్ల సంఖ్యలను తెలపండి.
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterDismissals AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id AS batter_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), BowlersWithTwo AS (SELECT bowler_id FROM BowlerBatterDismissals GROUP BY bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbd.dismissals FROM BowlerBatterDismissals bbd JOIN BowlersWithTwo bwt ON bbd.bowler_id = bwt.bowler_id JOIN Players pb ON bbd.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbd.batter_id = pb2.player_id ORDER BY pb.player_name, bbd.dismissals DESC;
gold_answer: ["('A Gardner', 'RM Ghosh', 5)", "('A Gardner', 'Shafali Verma', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'DN Wyatt', 6)", "('DB Sharma', 'AJ Healy', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'BL Mooney', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'AC Jayangani', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'TT Beaumont', 5)", "('GC Murtaza', 'GA Priandana', 6)", "('GC Murtaza', 'KD Kesuma', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'MS Chapman', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'JDS Neesham', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'DP Conway', 5)", "('S Ecclestone', 'CL Tryon', 5)", "('S Ecclestone', 'RM Ghosh', 5)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT bowler_id AS bowler, player_out_id AS batter, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
FROM Deliveries
WHERE match_type = 'T20I'
AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler_id, player_out_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਦੋ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਰ ਆਊਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ? ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼, ਦੋਵੇਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterDismissals AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id AS batter_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), BowlersWithTwo AS (SELECT bowler_id FROM BowlerBatterDismissals GROUP BY bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbd.dismissals FROM BowlerBatterDismissals bbd JOIN BowlersWithTwo bwt ON bbd.bowler_id = bwt.bowler_id JOIN Players pb ON bbd.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbd.batter_id = pb2.player_id ORDER BY pb.player_name, bbd.dismissals DESC;
gold_answer: ["('A Gardner', 'RM Ghosh', 5)", "('A Gardner', 'Shafali Verma', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'DN Wyatt', 6)", "('DB Sharma', 'AJ Healy', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'BL Mooney', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'AC Jayangani', 5)", "('DB Sharma', 'TT Beaumont', 5)", "('GC Murtaza', 'GA Priandana', 6)", "('GC Murtaza', 'KD Kesuma', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'MS Chapman', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'JDS Neesham', 5)", "('Haris Rauf', 'DP Conway', 5)", "('S Ecclestone', 'CL Tryon', 5)", "('S Ecclestone', 'RM Ghosh', 5)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    bowler_id AS bowler, 
    player_out_id AS batter, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_out_id) AS dismissals
FROM Deliveries
JOIN PlayerInMatch ON Deliveries.match_id = PlayerInMatch.match_id 
WHERE 
    team1 = 'India' OR team2 = 'India'
AND 
    PlayerInMatch.team_name = Deliveries.bowling_team
AND
    wicket_type != 'run out'
AND
    wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
AND
    wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
GROUP BY 
    bowler_id, player_out_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_out_id) >= 5;

question: In T20Is, what is the highest partnership recorded for Japan, and which wicket was it for?
gold_sql: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    teams.team_name AS partners,
    SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs,
    D.wicket_type AS wicket,
    M.match_date
FROM 
    Deliveries AS D
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS P1 ON D.striker_id = P1.player_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS P2 ON D.non_striker_id = P2.player_id
JOIN
    Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS team1 ON M.team1 = team1.team_name
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS team2 ON M.team2 = team2.team_name
WHERE 
    P1.team_name = team2.team_name AND
    P2.team_name = team1.team_name AND
    team1.team_name = 'Japan' AND
    MATCH(M.result_type) AGAINST ('*T20I*') 
    AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    teams.team_name, D.wicket_type, M.match_date
ORDER BY 
    runs DESC;

question: టీ20ఐలలో, ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో నలుగురు లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ మంది బ్యాట్స్‌మెన్‌లు రనౌట్ అయినప్పటికీ అత్యధిక స్కోరు నమోదు చేసి, మ్యాచ్‌లో ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు ఏది? ఆ జట్టు, స్కోరు, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టును తెలపండి
gold_sql: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  t2.team_name AS team,
  SUM(d2.runs_scored) AS score,
  t1.team_name AS opposition
FROM 
  Matches m
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch t1 ON m.match_id = t1.match_id AND t1.team_name = m.team1
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch t2 ON m.match_id = t2.match_id AND t2.team_name = m.team2
JOIN
  Deliveries d2 ON m.match_id = d2.match_id 
WHERE
  m.toss_winner = m.team1
  AND m.result_type = 'lost' 
  AND d2.inning = 1
  AND d2.wicket_type = 'run out'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = d2.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id
    HAVING COUNT(d.player_out_id) >= 4
  )
GROUP BY 
  t2.team_name, t1.team_name
ORDER BY 
  score DESC;

question: T20I 2026 ਵਿੱਚ, ਉਹ ਮੌਕਾ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 3 ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਰਨ ਆਊਟ ਹੋਏ? ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ, ਨਤੀਜਾ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, CASE WHEN m.match_winner = i.batting_team THEN 'Won' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 'No Result' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result, i.bowling_team AS opposition, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs = 3 LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    t1.team_name AS team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score,
    m.result_type AS result,
    t2.team_name AS opposition,
    m.season AS year
FROM Matches m
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS t1 ON m.match_id = t1.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS t2 ON m.team1 = t2.team_name AND m.team2 != t2.team_name
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
GROUP BY t1.team_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 END) >= 3 AND m.season = '2026' 
AND m.match_winner = t1.team_name;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, Japan ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਾਂਝੀਦਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਕਿਸ ਵਿਕਟ ਲਈ ਸੀ?
gold_sql: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p1.player_name AS partners,
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
  CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw') THEN d.wicket_type ELSE NULL END AS wicket,
  m.match_date
FROM 
  Players p1
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch pim ON p1.player_id = pim.player_id AND pim.team_name = 'Japan'
JOIN 
  Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
  Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE
  m.season = 'T20I'
  AND d.striker_id = p1.player_id
  AND d.batting_team = 'Japan'
  AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY 
  p1.player_name, m.match_date
ORDER BY 
  runs DESC;

question: In T20Is, among players with zero ducks in their career and 30+ innings, who has the highest strike rate? Return the player, team, strike rate, and innings.
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    pm.team_name AS team,
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / (SUM(d.delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))) AS strike_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS innings
FROM
    Players p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN
    Deliveries d ON pm.player_id = d.striker_id
GROUP BY
    p.player_id, pm.team_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) >= 30
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
    AND pm.team_name = 'Team1' 
    AND d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = 'T20')';

question: टी20I में, करियर में शून्य डक और 30 या उससे अधिक पारियां खेलने वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट किसका है? खिलाड़ी, टीम, स्ट्राइक रेट और पारियां बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    pm.team_name AS team,
    ROUND(((SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d 
    WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id 
    AND d.inning = 1 
    AND (wides = 0 AND noballs = 0)
    GROUP BY d.striker_id) 
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM Deliveries d 
    WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id 
    AND d.inning = 1 
    AND (wides = 0 AND noballs = 0))) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN match_id END)
    FROM PlayerInMatch pm
    WHERE pm.player_id = p.player_id AND pm.team_name = 'India') AS innings 
FROM Players p
INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
WHERE pm.team_name = 'India'
GROUP BY player_name, team
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN match_id END) >= 30
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC;

question: T20Iలలో జపాన్ తరఫున నమోదైన అత్యధిక భాగస్వామ్యం ఎంత, మరియు అది ఏ వికెట్‌కు నమోదైంది?
gold_sql: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    u.player_name AS partners,
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN d.wicket_type END) AS wicket,
    m.match_date
FROM Deliveries AS d
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
JOIN Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players AS u ON d.non_striker_id = u.player_id
WHERE
    m.team1 = 'Japan' OR m.team2 = 'Japan'
GROUP BY
    u.player_name, m.match_date
ORDER BY 
    runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਰੀਅਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਜ਼ੀਰੋ ਡੱਕ ਅਤੇ 30 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ? ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਟੀਮ, ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    pm.team_name AS team,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.wides) + SUM(d.noballs)) * 100, 2) as strike_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings
FROM Matches m
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON m.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN Players p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, pm.team_name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) > 0
    AND (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.wides) + SUM(d.noballs)) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) >= 30;

question: T20I లలో, తమ కెరీర్‌లో ఒక్కసారి కూడా డకౌట్ కాకుండా 30కి పైగా ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లు ఆడిన ఆటగాళ్లలో, అత్యధిక స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఎవరిది? ఆ ఆటగాడి పేరు, జట్టు, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ మరియు ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లను తెలపండి
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    pIM.team_name AS team,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (SUM(d.balls_faced) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS strike_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS innings
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pIM ON p.player_id = pIM.player_id
JOIN
    Deliveries d ON pIM.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    pIM.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'South Africa', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'Bangladesh', 'Afghanistan', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe', 'Ireland', 'Kenya', 'Namibia')
    AND d.runout = '0'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
    AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
    AND  
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) >= 30
GROUP BY
    p.player_name, pIM.team_name 
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) > 0
ORDER BY
    strike_rate DESC;

question: T20Iలలో, ఏ బౌలర్-బ్యాటర్ జోడికి  అత్యధిక డిస్మిసల్స్ ఉన్నాయి  మరియు ఆ బౌలర్‌పై బ్యాటర్ సగటు ఎంత?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d1.bowler_id AS bowler,
    d1.striker_id AS batter,
    COUNT(d1.delivery_id) AS dismissals,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE d1.runs_scored END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 2) AS batting_average
FROM Deliveries AS d1
JOIN Players AS p1 ON d1.bowler_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d2 ON d1.striker_id = d2.bowler_id
WHERE d1.match_id = d2.match_id
AND p1.player_name NOT LIKE '%retired%'
AND d1.inning = 1
GROUP BY d1.bowler_id, d1.striker_id
ORDER BY dismissals DESC;

question: टी20I में, कितनी बार किसी टीम ने 220 या उससे अधिक रन बनाए जब विपक्ष ने केवल पांच गेंदबाज़ों का उपयोग किया और फिर भी मैच हार गया? टीमों, स्कोर और विपक्षी टीमों को बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS grand_total_instances, 
    batting_team AS team, 
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS score,
    bowling_team AS opposition,
    match_date
FROM 
    Matches M
INNER JOIN 
    Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
INNER JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch PM ON M.match_id = PM.match_id
WHERE 
    M.result_type = 'match'
    AND M.toss_decision = 'bat'
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN bowler_id = D.bowler_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 5
    AND SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) >= 220
    AND (striker_id  IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE match_id = M.match_id AND team_name = batting_team)
       AND  bowler_id  IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE match_id = M.match_id AND team_name = bowling_team))
    AND D.wides = 0 
    AND D.noballs = 0
GROUP BY
    M.match_id, batting_team, bowling_team, match_date
order by 
    match_date;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿੰਨੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 220 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਪੰਜ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਮੈਚ ਹਾਰ ਗਈ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS grand_total_instances,
    team1 AS team,
    SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS score,
    team2 AS opposition,
    match_date
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.match_date,
        d.batting_team AS team1,
        CASE
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS team2,
        d.match_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as runs_scored
    FROM Matches AS m

    WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
    AND m.season = 'T20I'
    AND d.inning = 1
    AND  m.team1 <> m.team2
    GROUP BY m.match_id) AS tt
WHERE runs_scored >= 220 
    AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = tt.match_id) <= 5
GROUP BY tt.match_id, team1, team2, match_date
ORDER BY grand_total_instances DESC;

question: In T20Is, SR Watson scored the highest individual runs on the losing side. What was his score, which team did he represent, and who was the opposition?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score,
        pm.team_name AS team,
        CASE 
            WHEN pm.team_name = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition,
        m.match_date
    FROM
        Deliveries AS d
    JOIN
        PlayerInMatch AS pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
    JOIN
        Matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE
        pm.player_id = 'SRW' 
        AND m.season = 'T20I'
        AND d.wickets = 0
        AND Striker_id = 'SRW'
    GROUP BY
        p.player_name, pm.team_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date
)
SELECT
    player_name AS PlayerName,
    MAX(score) AS Score,
    team AS Team,
    opposition AS Opposition,
    match_date AS MatchDate
FROM PlayerRuns  
GROUP BY 
    player_name, team, opposition, match_date
ORDER BY 
    score DESC 
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?
gold_sql: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;
gold_answer: ["('England', 'West Indies', 'County Ground', 8)", "('India', 'Bangladesh', 'Sylhet International Cricket Stadium', 6)", "('New Zealand', 'Zimbabwe', 'Harare Sports Club', 5)", "('Pakistan', 'Zimbabwe', 'Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium', 5)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team1 AS team,
    team2 AS opponent,
    Matches.venue AS venue,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'win' THEN 1 END) AS wins
FROM Matches
WHERE
    team1 NOT IN (SELECT team2 FROM Matches)
GROUP BY
    team1, team2, Matches.venue
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'win' THEN 1 END) > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Matches m2
        WHERE m2.team1 = team1
        AND m2.team2 = team2
        AND m2.venue = Matches.venue
        AND m2.result_type <> 'win'
    )
ORDER BY
    wins DESC;

question: టీ20ఐలలో, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు కేవలం ఐదుగురు బౌలర్లను మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు, ఒక జట్టు 220+ పరుగులు చేసినప్పటికీ ఎన్నిసార్లు మ్యాచ్‌లో ఓడిపోయింది? ఆ జట్ల పేర్లు, స్కోర్లు మరియు ప్రత్యర్థి జట్లను తెలపండి

question: टी20I में जापान के लिए दर्ज सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी कौन-सी है, और वह किस विकेट के लिए थी?
gold_sql: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    team1||' & '||team2 AS partners,
    MAX(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS runs,
    CASE
        WHEN wicket_type = 'bowled' THEN 'Bowled'
        WHEN wicket_type = 'lbw' THEN 'LBW'
        WHEN wicket_type = 'caught' THEN 'Caught'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS wicket,
    m.match_date
FROM  
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY 
    team1||' & '||team2, m.match_date
HAVING 
    d.ball_number = 6 AND
    d.striker_id NOT IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE team_name = 'Other') AND
    d.inning = 1 AND
    m.toss_winner = 'japan' AND
    m.result_type = 'victory' AND
    m.season = 'T20I'
ORDER BY 
    runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cups में India के लिए सबसे बड़े व्यक्तिगत स्कोर कौन से हैं?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out, m.venue, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'India' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.venue, m.season, opponent ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('Abhishek Sharma', 135, '', 'Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2024/25', 'England')", "('Shubman Gill', 126, '*', 'Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad', '2022/23', 'New Zealand')", "('RD Gaikwad', 123, '*', 'Barsapara Cricket Stadium, Guwahati', '2023/24', 'Australia')", "('Tilak Varma', 120, '*', 'The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg', '2024/25', 'South Africa')", "('RG Sharma', 118, '', 'Holkar Cricket Stadium', '2017/18', 'Sri Lanka')", "('SA Yadav', 117, '', 'Trent Bridge, Nottingham', '2022', 'England')", "('SA Yadav', 112, '*', 'Saurashtra Cricket Association Stadium, Rajkot', '2022/23', 'Sri Lanka')", "('S Mandhana', 112, '', 'Trent Bridge, Nottingham', '2025', 'England')", "('RG Sharma', 111, '*', 'Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium', '2018/19', 'West Indies')", "('SA Yadav', 111, '*', 'Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui', '2022/23', 'New Zealand')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    (d.runs_scored IS NULL) AS not_out,
    m.venue,
    m.season,
    m.team2 AS opponent
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND d.batting_team = 'India'
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.venue, m.season

question: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) AS grand_total_instances,
    t1.team_name AS team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score,
    t2.team_name AS opposition,
    m.match_date
FROM Matches AS m
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS mi ON m.match_id = mi.match_id
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS t1 ON mi.match_id = t1.match_id AND t1.team_name = d.batting_team
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS t2 ON mi.match_id = t2.match_id AND t2.team_name = d.bowling_team
GROUP BY 
    m.match_id, t1.team_name, t2.team_name, m.match_date
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 220 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) = 5;

question: T20 में Sanju Samson और Jason Holder के बीच आमना-सामना का रिकॉर्ड क्या है?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Holder%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  D.striker_id AS batter,
  D.bowler_id AS bowler,
  SUM(D.ball_number) AS balls,
  SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS dismissals,
  ROUND(SUM(D.runs_scored) / COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wicket_type IS NULL THEN 1 END), 2) AS average,
  ROUND((SUM(D.runs_scored) / ((SUM(D.ball_number) / 6)) * 100), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM
  Deliveries AS D
JOIN
  PlayerInMatch AS P1 ON D.striker_id = P1.player_id AND P1.team_name = V
JOIN
  PlayerInMatch AS P2 ON D.bowler_id = P2.player_id AND P2.team_name <> V
WHERE
  P1.player_id = 'Sanju Samson' AND P2.player_id = 'Jason Holder' AND D.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'T20') AND D.runs_scored IS NOT NULL AND D.wickte_type  NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY
  batter, bowler
ORDER BY 
  batter ASC;

question: What is the T20 head-to-head record of Sanju Samson against Jason Holder?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Holder%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerSummaries AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN PlayerInMatch.team_name = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN PlayerInMatch.player_id ELSE NULL END AS batter_id,
        CASE WHEN PlayerInMatch.team_name <> 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN PlayerInMatch.player_id ELSE NULL END AS bowler_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    LEFT JOIN Deliveries ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
        AND PlayerInMatch.player_id = Deliveries.striker_id
    WHERE
        Deliveries.bowler_id = 'Jason Holder'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN PlayerInMatch.team_name = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN NULL END AS batter_id,
        CASE WHEN PlayerInMatch.team_name <> 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN NULL END AS bowler_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    LEFT JOIN Deliveries ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
        AND PlayerInMatch.player_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
    WHERE
        Deliveries.striker_id = 'Sanju Samson'
),
SpecificMatcher AS (
    SELECT
        batter_id,
        bowler_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.wicket_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.wicket_type IS NULL THEN Deliveries.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals
    FROM PlayerSummaries
    JOIN Deliveries
        ON PlayerSummaries.batter_id = Deliveries.striker_id AND PlayerSummaries.bowler_id = Deliveries.bowler_id
    WHERE
        Deliveries.inning = 1
    GROUP BY
        batter_id,
        bowler_id
)
SELECT
    batter AS batter,
    bowler AS bowler,
    balls,
    runs,
    dismissals,
    CASE WHEN balls <> 0 THEN round(runs / balls, 2) ELSE 0 END AS average,
    CASE WHEN balls <> 0 THEN round((runs / balls) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN batter_id IS NOT NULL THEN batter_id AS batter
            ELSE bowler_id AS batter
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN bowler_id IS NOT NULL THEN bowler_id AS bowler
            ELSE batter_id AS bowler
        END
    FROM SpecificMatcher
) AS stemmed 
ORDER BY batter, bowler;

gold_sql: WITH batting_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 40 ), bowling_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.bowler_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowler_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) >= 2 ), combined AS ( SELECT b.match_id, b.striker_id AS player_id, b.runs, bw.wickets, bw.runs_conceded FROM batting_innings b JOIN bowling_innings bw ON b.match_id = bw.match_id AND b.striker_id = bw.bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, c.runs, c.wickets, c.runs_conceded, m.venue, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = (SELECT pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.match_id = c.match_id AND pim.player_id = c.player_id LIMIT 1) THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM combined c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON c.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY c.runs DESC;

        ELSE M.team1
    END AS opponent
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches M ON pim.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN Deliveries D ON pim.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
    M.season = '2026'
    AND D.inning = 1  
    AND p.player_id = D.bowler_id
GROUP BY 
    player_name, venue, season, opponent
HAVING
    SUM(D.runs_scored) >= 40
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) >= 2;

question: Which players have scored the most 50-plus scores in season 2026?

question: सीज़न 2026 में किसी भी विकेट के लिए सबसे बड़ी साझेदारियाँ कौन सी हैं?
gold_sql: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.delivery_id, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) AS wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) ) SELECT p.runs, p.wicket_num + 1 AS wicket, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.runs DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH RankedPartnerships AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(d1.runs_scored + IF(d1.runs_scored IS NULL, 0, d1.runs_scored)) AS runs,
        d2.wicket_type AS wicket,
        p1.player_name AS team1,
        p2.player_name AS team2,
        m.venue,
        m.season
    FROM Deliveries AS d1
    JOIN Deliveries AS d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND d1.inning = d2.inning AND d1.over_number = d2.over_number
    JOIN Matches AS m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id AND p1.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p2 ON d2.non_striker_id = p2.player_id AND p2.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE
        d1.wicket_type <> 'run out'
        AND d1.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt'
        AND d1.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field'
        AND m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY m.match_id
);

SELECT 
    runs, 
    wicket, 
    team1, 
    team2, 
    venue, 
    season
FROM RankedPartnerships
ORDER BY runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cups में Pakistan के लिए सबसे बड़े व्यक्तिगत स्कोर कौन से हैं?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out, m.venue, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.venue, m.season, opponent ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10;

    m.season as season,
    m.team2 as opponent

question: What are the highest targets successfully chased in 18–20 overs in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH chasing_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_chased, MAX(d.over_number) AS last_over FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team ), last_wicket_over AS ( SELECT match_id, MAX(over_number) AS over_completed FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT ci.batting_team AS chasing_team, ci.runs_chased, lwo.over_completed AS overs_used, m.venue, m.season FROM chasing_innings ci JOIN Matches m ON ci.match_id = m.match_id JOIN last_wicket_over lwo ON ci.match_id = lwo.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = ci.batting_team AND lwo.over_completed >= 17 ORDER BY ci.runs_chased DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('Bulgaria', 246, 19, 'National Sports Academy, Sofia', '2022')", "('Australia', 245, 18, 'Eden Park', '2017/18')", "('West Indies', 236, 17, 'New Wanderers Stadium', '2014/15')", "('England', 230, 19, 'Wankhede Stadium', '2015/16')", "('Bulgaria', 229, 19, 'National Sports Academy, Sofia', '2022')", "('England', 226, 18, 'SuperSport Park', '2019/20')", '(\'England\', 226, 17, "National Cricket Stadium, St George\'s, Grenada", \'2023/24\')', "('Singapore', 216, 18, 'Terdthai Cricket Ground, Bangkok', '2023/24')", "('Bangladesh', 215, 18, 'R.Premadasa Stadium, Khettarama', '2017/18')", "('Tanzania', 215, 17, 'TCA Oval, Blantyre', '2025')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.team2 AS chasing_team,
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS runs_chased,
    m.match_date, 
    m.venue,
    m.season
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.stage = 'T20 World Cup' 
    AND m.team1 = (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE match_id = m.match_id AND player_id = m.toss_winner)
    AND m.overs_used BETWEEN 18 AND 20
    AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY 
    m.team2, m.match_id;

question: T20I में 50 विकेट तक पहुंचने के लिए सबसे कम मैच किस Pakistan गेंदबाज ने खेले?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_match_wickets AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_match FROM Deliveries d JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.bowler_id = pim.player_id AND d.match_id = pim.match_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT bowler_id, match_id, wickets_in_match, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id) AS match_seq, SUM(wickets_in_match) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_wickets FROM bowler_match_wickets ), milestone AS ( SELECT bowler_id, MIN(match_seq) AS matches_to_50 FROM ranked WHERE cum_wickets >= 50 GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, m.matches_to_50 FROM milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY m.matches_to_50 LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('Umar Gul', 34)", "('Saeed Ajmal', 35)", "('Abrar Ahmed', 36)", "('Shadab Khan', 37)", "('Shahid Afridi', 38)", "('Hasan Ali', 38)", "('Haris Rauf', 40)", "('Mohammad Amir', 41)", "('Sadia Iqbal', 42)", "('Shaheen Shah Afridi', 43)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) AS matches_to_50
FROM 
  Players p
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch mi ON p.player_id = mi.player_id
JOIN 
  Matches m ON mi.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
  Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
  d.bowler_id = p.player_id 
AND 
  d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'run out') 
AND 
  m.toss_winner = 'Pakistan'
AND 
  p.player_name LIKE '%Pakistan%'
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT mi.match_id) <= 
(
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT mi2.match_id) 
  FROM 
    PlayerInMatch mi2
  JOIN 
    Matches m2 ON mi2.match_id = m2.match_id
  WHERE 
    m2.toss_winner = 'Pakistan'
    AND mi2.team_name = 'Pakistan'
    AND p.player_name LIKE '%Pakistan%'
  GROUP BY 
    mi2.match_id
