        SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals
    FROM 
        Deliveries
    JOIN
        Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
    JOIN
        PlayerInMatch ON Matches.match_id = PlayerInMatch.match_id
    JOIN
        Players ON Deliveries.striker_id = Players.player_id
    WHERE 
        Matches.result_type = 'T20I'
    AND 
        (Players.player_name = 'Tim Seifert' AND Deliveries.bowler_id = 'Adil Rashid' OR Players.player_name = 'Adil Rashid' AND Deliveries.striker_id = 'Tim Seifert')
    AND 
        Deliveries.wides = 0 
    AND 
        Deliveries.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        Players.player_name, Players.player_name, Deliveries.inning
) 

SELECT 
    batter,
    bowler,
    inning,
    runs,
    balls,
    dismissals,
    CASE 
        WHEN balls > 0 THEN (runs / balls) * 100 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS strike_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Deliveries.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes
FROM 
    PlayerStats
GROUP BY 
    batter, bowler, inning
ORDER BY 
	batter,bowler,inning;

gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Ravindra%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Curran%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;

  p1.player_name AS batter, 
  p2.player_name AS bowler, 
  d.inning, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, 
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals
FROM Players AS p1
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim1 ON p1.player_id = pim1.player_id

JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim2 ON pim2.match_id = m.match_id AND pim2.team_name = CASE WHEN pim1.team_name = 'team1' THEN 'team2' ELSE 'team1' END
JOIN Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id

GROUP BY p1.player_name, p2.player_name, d.inning;

question: Which T20 match has seen the most sixes in season 2026, and what are the top three instances?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
WITH Sevens AS (
SELECT
    D.batting_team AS team1,
    D.bowling_team AS team2,
    M.venue,
    M.season,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN D.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes
FROM
    Deliveries D
JOIN
    Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
WHERE
    M.season = '2026'
GROUP BY
    D.batting_team,
    D.bowling_team,
    M.venue,
    M.season
)
SELECT
    team1 AS team1,
    team2 AS team2,
    venue AS venue,
    season AS season,
    sixes AS sixes
FROM
    Sevens
ORDER BY
    sixes DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: T20I లో Tim Seifert vs Adil Rashid మధ్య హెడ్-టు-హెడ్ రికార్డు ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),1) AS strike_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored=4 AND d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS fours, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored=6 AND d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Seifert%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Rashid%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    s.player_name AS batter,
    r.player_name AS bowler,
    d.inning,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS balls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS dismissals,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 4 THEN 1 END) AS fours,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes
FROM
    Deliveries d
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch p1 ON d.match_id = p1.match_id AND d.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN
    Players s ON p1.player_id = s.player_id
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch p2 ON d.match_id = p2.match_id AND d.bowler_id = p2.player_id
JOIN
    Players r ON p2.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE
    r.player_name = 'Adil Rashid' AND s.player_name = 'Tim Seifert' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY
    s.player_name, r.player_name, d.inning
ORDER BY
    s.player_name, r.player_name;

question: T20 World Cups ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਰਤੀ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 5;

    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 AND d.wicket_type <> 'run out' AND d.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
FROM 
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches AS m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'T20 World Cup' AND p.player_name LIKE 'India%'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    wickets DESC;

question: What is the highest partnership for Zimbabwe in T20 World Cups for any wicket?
gold_sql: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Zimbabwe' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) AS wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) ) SELECT p.runs, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.runs DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["(144, 'Zimbabwe', 'Seychelles', 'Gymkhana Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')", "(138, 'Zimbabwe', 'Gambia', 'Ruaraka Sports Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')", "(134, 'Zimbabwe', 'Namibia', 'Centre for Cricket Development Ground, Windhoek', '2022')", "(134, 'Zimbabwe', 'Tanzania', 'Harare Sports Club', '2025/26')", "(125, 'Zimbabwe', 'Rwanda', 'Ruaraka Sports Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')"]

SELECT 
    MAX(SUM(RunsScored)) AS runs,
    p1.player_name AS team1,
    p2.player_name AS team2,
    M.venue,
    M.season
FROM 
    Deliveries AS D
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS PIM1 ON D.match_id = PIM1.match_id AND D.striker_id = PIM1.player_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS PIM2 ON D.match_id = PIM2.match_id AND D.non_striker_id = PIM2.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN 
    Players AS p1 ON PIM1.player_id = p1.player_id
JOIN 
    Players AS p2 ON PIM2.player_id = p2.player_id
WHERE 
    p1.player_name = 'Zimbabwe' 
    OR p2.player_name = 'Zimbabwe'
    AND result_type != "Tie"
    AND strftime('%Y', M.match_date, 'unixepoch') > 2000
    AND strftime('%Y', M.match_date, 'unixepoch') < 2023
    AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    M.venue, M.season 
ORDER BY 
    runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cups में Zimbabwe की किसी भी विकेट के लिए सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी कौन सी है?
gold_sql: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Zimbabwe' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) AS wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) ) SELECT p.runs, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.runs DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["(144, 'Zimbabwe', 'Seychelles', 'Gymkhana Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')", "(138, 'Zimbabwe', 'Gambia', 'Ruaraka Sports Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')", "(134, 'Zimbabwe', 'Namibia', 'Centre for Cricket Development Ground, Windhoek', '2022')", "(134, 'Zimbabwe', 'Tanzania', 'Harare Sports Club', '2025/26')", "(125, 'Zimbabwe', 'Rwanda', 'Ruaraka Sports Club Ground, Nairobi', '2024/25')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(t1.runs_scored) AS runs,
    p1.team_name AS team1,
    p2.team_name AS team2,
    m.venue,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries t1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch p1 ON t1.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch p2 ON t1.bowler_id = p2.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON t1.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season LIKE '%T20%'
    AND t1.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'run out')

    runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 World Cups में सबसे अधिक विकेट लेने वाले भारतीय गेंदबाज कौन हैं?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type != 'run out' AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE
    m.season LIKE 'T20 World Cup %' AND pim.team_name = 'India'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    wickets DESC;

question: T20 World Cups में किसी भारतीय द्वारा डाला गया सबसे महंगा ओवर कौन सा है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_in_over FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY runs_in_over DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  Players.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored + Deliveries.extra_runs) AS runs_in_over
FROM Players
JOIN PlayerInMatch ON Players.player_id = PlayerInMatch.player_id
JOIN Deliveries ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE 
  Matches.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
  AND Players.player_name LIKE '%India%'
  AND Deliveries.wides = 0
  AND Deliveries.noballs = 0
  AND Deliveries.bowler_id = Players.player_id
GROUP BY 
  Players.player_name
ORDER BY 
  runs_in_over DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20Is में 1000 से अधिक रन बनाने और 50 से अधिक विकेट लेने वाले खिलाड़ी कौन हैं?
gold_sql: WITH career_batting AS ( SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS career_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id ), career_bowling AS ( SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS career_wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, cb.career_runs, cw.career_wickets FROM career_batting cb JOIN career_bowling cw ON cb.striker_id = cw.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON cb.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE cb.career_runs >= 1000 AND cw.career_wickets >= 50 ORDER BY cb.career_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS career_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'lbw', 'caught', 'stumped', 'run out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS career_wickets

question: Full Member टीमों के लिए लगातार T20I पारियों में कम से कम एक विकेट लेने वाले गेंदबाज कौन हैं?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_innings AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS took_wicket FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id, took_wicket ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS grp FROM bowler_innings ), streaks AS ( SELECT bowler_id, took_wicket, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked WHERE took_wicket = 1 GROUP BY bowler_id, grp, took_wicket ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.streak_len) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('RP Yadav', 27)", "('AU Rashid', 24)", "('S Lamichhane', 24)", "('ML Schutt', 23)", "('PWH de Silva', 23)", "('CV Varun', 22)", "('S Ecclestone', 20)", "('AR Ramjani', 19)", "('Arshdeep Singh', 18)", "('Al-Amin Hossain', 18)"]
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerBOWLINGS AS (
    SELECT
        bowdler_id,
        match_id,
        SUM((wides = 0 AND noballs = 0) AND wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field') AS wickets
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY bowdler_id, match_id
),
ConsecutiveWicket AS (
    SELECT
        bowdler_id,
        player_id,
        MAX(match_id) as last_match_id,
        MAX(COUNT(match_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY bowdler_id ORDER BY match_id) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
    FROM PlayerBOWLINGS
    GROUP BY bowdler_id
),
PlayerInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        P.player_name,
        C.max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
    FROM Players AS P
    JOIN ConsecutiveWicket AS C ON P.player_id = C.bowdler_id)
SELECT 
    player_name, 
    max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
FROM PlayerInfo
WHERE  
    team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'West Indies') ;

question: T20Is లో 1000+ రన్లు చేసి 50+ వికెట్లు తీసిన ఆటగాళ్ళు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: WITH career_batting AS ( SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS career_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id ), career_bowling AS ( SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS career_wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, cb.career_runs, cw.career_wickets FROM career_batting cb JOIN career_bowling cw ON cb.striker_id = cw.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON cb.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE cb.career_runs >= 1000 AND cw.career_wickets >= 50 ORDER BY cb.career_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS career_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type <> 'run out' AND d.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) AS career_wickets
FROM Players AS p
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches AS m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
LEFT JOIN Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE m.stage = 'T20I'
GROUP BY p.player_id
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs)  >= 1000 
AND COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type <> 'run out' AND d.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt' AND d.wicket_type <> 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 END) >= 50;

question: Full Member జట్ల తరఫున వరుస T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో కనీసం ఒక వికెట్ తీసిన బౌలర్లు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_innings AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS took_wicket FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id, took_wicket ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS grp FROM bowler_innings ), streaks AS ( SELECT bowler_id, took_wicket, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked WHERE took_wicket = 1 GROUP BY bowler_id, grp, took_wicket ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.streak_len) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('RP Yadav', 27)", "('AU Rashid', 24)", "('S Lamichhane', 24)", "('ML Schutt', 23)", "('PWH de Silva', 23)", "('CV Varun', 22)", "('S Ecclestone', 20)", "('AR Ramjani', 19)", "('Arshdeep Singh', 18)", "('Al-Amin Hossain', 18)"]

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    MAX(
      CASE 
        WHEN d1.delivery_id = d2.delivery_id THEN COUNT(d1.delivery_id)
        ELSE -1
      END
    ) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
FROM 
    Players AS p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS d1 ON pim.match_id = d1.match_id AND p.player_id = d1.bowler_id

HAVING

      CASE 
        WHEN d1.delivery_id = d2.delivery_id THEN COUNT(d1.delivery_id)
        ELSE -1
      END
    ) > 0

    p.player_name;

question: Which players have scored 1000+ runs and taken 50+ wickets in T20Is?

    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS career_runs,

question: Which team was the first to concede 250+ runs in successive T20I innings?

gold_sql: WITH innings_total AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_date ), successive AS ( SELECT it.bowling_team, it.match_date, it.runs_conceded, LAG(it.runs_conceded) OVER ( PARTITION BY it.bowling_team ORDER BY it.match_date, it.match_id, it.inning ) AS prev_runs FROM innings_total it ) SELECT bowling_team, match_date, runs_conceded, prev_runs FROM successive WHERE runs_conceded >= 250 AND prev_runs >= 250 ORDER BY match_date LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    bt.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
    m.match_date AS match_date,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,

gold_sql: WITH bowler_innings AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS took_wicket FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id, took_wicket ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS grp FROM bowler_innings ), streaks AS ( SELECT bowler_id, took_wicket, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked WHERE took_wicket = 1 GROUP BY bowler_id, grp, took_wicket ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.streak_len) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What are the top two highest-scoring partnerships at the best run rates in season 2026?
gold_sql: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs, ROUND(SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS run_rate FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, wicket_num HAVING SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) >= 50 ) SELECT p.runs, p.run_rate, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.run_rate DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH RankedPartnerships AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS runs,
    CAST(SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS REAL) / ((SUM(d1.over_number) + (SUM(d1.ball_number) / 6)) * 6) AS run_rate,
    pm.team_name AS team1, 
    CASE 
        WHEN pm2.team_name < pm.team_name THEN pm2.team_name 
        ELSE pm.team_name 
    END AS team2,
    m.venue, 
    m.season
  FROM 
    PlayerInMatch pm
  JOIN 
    Matches m ON pm.`match_id` = m.match_id
  JOIN 
    Deliveries d1 ON pm.`player_id` = d1.striker_id AND m.match_id = d1.match_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pm2 
    ON m.match_id = pm2.`match_id` AND pm.`player_id` != pm2.`player_id`
  WHERE 
    m.season = '2026'
    AND d1.wides = 0
    AND d1.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY
    pm.team_name, pm2.team_name, m.venue, m.season
  ORDER BY 
    run_rate DESC
  
  
)
SELECT 
  runs,
  run_rate,
  team1,
  team2,
  venue,
  season
FROM
  RankedPartnerships
LIMIT 2;

WITH TeamBattingAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.batting_team AS team1,
        d2.batting_team AS team2,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) AS runs,
        COUNT(d1.delivery_id) AS deliveries
    FROM Deliveries d1
    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND d1.inning = d2.inning
    WHERE d1.match_id = d2.match_id
    AND d1.inning = d2.inning

    AND d1.wides = 0 AND d1.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d1.batting_team, d2.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    runs,
    runs / deliveries AS run_rate,
    team1,
    team2,
    m.venue,
    m.season
FROM TeamBattingAvg
JOIN Matches m ON TeamBattingAvg.runs = m.match_id
ORDER BY run_rate DESC

question: Which Indian batting feat marked the first time three or more batters scored 20+ runs at a 150+ strike rate in a T20 innings in season 2026?
gold_sql: WITH batter_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sr FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id ), qualifying AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, COUNT(*) AS qualifiers FROM batter_innings WHERE runs >= 20 AND sr >= 150 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT q.batting_team, q.qualifiers, m.venue, m.match_date, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = q.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM qualifying q JOIN Matches m ON q.match_id = m.match_id WHERE q.batting_team = 'India' ORDER BY m.match_date LIMIT 5;

  dt.batting_team AS batting_team,
  SUM(dlv.runs_scored) AS pp_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dlv.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pp_wickets,
  m.venue,
  m.season,
  m.team2 AS opponent
FROM
  Deliveries AS dlv
JOIN
  Matches AS m ON dlv.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN
  PlayerInMatch AS pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
WHERE
  dt.batting_team = 'India' 
  AND dlv.over_number <= 6
  AND m.stage = 'Final'
  AND m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
GROUP BY
  dt.batting_team, m.venue, m.season, m.team2
ORDER BY
  pp_runs DESC;

question: Which bowlers have conceded the most runs in their first-ever over in T20 season 2026?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_first_wc_match AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, MIN(d.match_id) AS first_match_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id ), first_over AS ( SELECT bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, MIN(d.over_number) AS first_over_num FROM bowler_first_wc_match bfwm JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = bfwm.bowler_id AND d.match_id = bfwm.first_match_id GROUP BY bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning ), first_over_runs AS ( SELECT fo.bowler_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM first_over fo JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = fo.bowler_id AND d.match_id = fo.match_id AND d.inning = fo.inning AND d.over_number = fo.first_over_num GROUP BY fo.bowler_id, fo.match_id ) SELECT p.player_name, fr.runs_conceded FROM first_over_runs fr JOIN Players p ON fr.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY fr.runs_conceded DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  P.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded
FROM Players AS P
JOIN Deliveries AS D ON P.player_id = D.bowler_id
WHERE D.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026' )
  AND D.over_number = 1
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC;

question: What is Sanju Samson’s T20 batting record at Chepauk?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(s.runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(s.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.dismissed),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(s.runs)*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.balls),0),2) AS strike_rate, MAX(s.runs) AS high_score FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND (m.venue LIKE '%Chepauk%' OR m.city LIKE '%Chennai%') GROUP BY p.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS innings,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.id), 2) AS average,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AND 
    (d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) > 0) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate,
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS high_score
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN
    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE 
    p.player_name = 'Sanju Samson'
  AND d.venue = 'Chepauk'
  AND d.legbyes = 0
  AND d.byes = 0
  AND d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name

ORDER BY 
    player_name;

question: What is India’s average for the first wicket in 2026 T20 World Cup?
gold_sql: WITH first_wkt AS ( SELECT sub.match_id, sub.inning, SUM(sub.runs_scored + sub.byes + sub.legbyes) AS opening_runs FROM ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.delivery_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wkts_before FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' AND m.season = '2025/26' ) sub WHERE sub.wkts_before = 0 GROUP BY sub.match_id, sub.inning ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(opening_runs) * 1.0, 2) AS avg_first_wicket_partnership FROM first_wkt;
generated_sql:
SELECT AVG(d1.runs_scored) AS avg_first_wicket_partnership

FROM Deliveries AS d1
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON d1.match_id = pim.match_id AND d1.bowler_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches AS m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = '2026'
AND m.team1 = 'India' OR m.team2 = 'India'
AND d1.inning = 1
AND d1.ball_number = 1
AND d1.wicket_type != 'run out'
AND d1.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
AND d1.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field'
GROUP BY pim.player_id ORDERED BY pim.player_id;

question: What are the most expensive bowling figures in season 2026?

question: सीज़न 2026 में Sikandar Raza ने Ravi Bishnoi के खिलाफ कैसा प्रदर्शन किया है?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Raza%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Bishnoi%' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerData AS (
    SELECT 
        P1.player_name AS batter,
        P2.player_name AS bowler,
        D.inning,
        SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs,
        SUM(D.ball_number) AS balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN D.wicket_type != 'run out' AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND D.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals
    FROM Players P1
    JOIN Matches M ON P1.player_id = M.player_of_match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM ON P1.player_id = PIM.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries D ON PIM.match_id = D.match_id
    JOIN Players P2 ON D.bowler_id = P2.player_id
    WHERE 
        M.season = '2026' 
        AND P1.player_id = 'Sikandar Raza'
        AND P2.player_id = 'Ravi Bishnoi'
    GROUP BY P1.player_name, P2.player_name, D.inning
)
SELECT 
    batter,
    bowler,
    inning,
    runs,
    balls,
    dismissals,
    CASE WHEN balls > 0 THEN runs / balls ELSE 0 END AS average,
    CASE WHEN runs > 0 THEN (runs / balls) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
FROM PlayerData;

      batting_team AS BattingTeam,
      season AS Season,
      (
          SELECT
              SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sixes
          FROM Deliveries
          WHERE batting_team = D.batting_team
              AND inning = 1
              AND wides = 0
              AND noballs = 0
      ) AS Sixes,

              SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          FROM Deliveries
          WHERE batting_team = D.batting_team

              AND noballs = 0

ORDER BY Sixes DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Who has made the most appearances in Men’s T20 World Cup knockouts?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS knockout_appearances FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON pim.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY knockout_appearances DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('H Kaur', 7)", "('JDS Neesham', 6)", "('GD Phillips', 6)", "('DB Sharma', 5)", "('Arshdeep Singh', 5)", "('AU Rashid', 5)", "('SA Yadav', 5)", "('AR Patel', 5)", "('S Mandhana', 5)", "('Renuka Singh', 5)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS knockout_appearances
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.stage LIKE '%Knockout%'
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY knockout_appearances DESC;

question: पुरुष T20 World Cups में सबसे अधिक मैच किसने खेले हैं?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS appearances FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND (m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') OR m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe')) GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY appearances DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('SA Yadav', 59)", "('Babar Azam', 55)", "('AU Rashid', 54)", "('MD Shanaka', 52)", "('P Nissanka', 51)", "('JDS Neesham', 51)", "('JC Buttler', 49)", "('PR Stirling', 48)", "('MR Adair', 48)", "('DB Sharma', 47)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS appearances
FROM
    Players p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE

   AND m.season IN ('2007', '2009', '2010', '2012', '2014', '2016', '2020', '2022')
GROUP BY
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    appearances DESC;

question: T20 World Cup ఒక ఎడిషన్‌లో India తరఫున అత్యధిక సిక్సర్లు కొట్టిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    m.season AS season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes
FROM
    Players AS p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch AS pim ON p.player_id=pim.player_id
JOIN
    Matches AS m ON pim.match_id=m.match_id
JOIN
    Deliveries AS d ON m.match_id=d.match_id AND p.player_id=d.striker_id
WHERE
    m.team1='India' OR m.team2='India'
GROUP BY
    p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY
    sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20Is और T20 World Cups में India का England के खिलाफ आमना-सामना रिकॉर्ड क्या है?
gold_sql: SELECT 'Overall T20Is' AS context, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS england_wins, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Matches m WHERE (m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India') UNION ALL SELECT 'T20 World Cups', SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India'));

SELECT 
    'T20I Matches' AS context,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'India' THEN 1 END) AS india_wins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'England' THEN 1 END) AS england_wins,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Matches
WHERE team1 = 'India' AND team2 = 'England' AND season LIKE 'ICC T20 World Cup%' OR  
      team1 = 'England' AND team2 = 'India' AND season LIKE 'ICC T20 World Cup%' 

UNION ALL

    'T20 World Cup Matches' AS context,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'India' THEN 1 END) AS india_wins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'England' THEN 1 END) AS england_wins,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Matches
WHERE team1 = 'India' AND team2 = 'England' AND season != 'ICC T20 World Cup'

question: What is India’s head-to-head record against England in T20Is and T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: SELECT 'Overall T20Is' AS context, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS england_wins, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Matches m WHERE (m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India') UNION ALL SELECT 'T20 World Cups', SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India'));
generated_sql:
WITH T20WorldCupMatches AS (
    SELECT
        'T20 World Cup' AS context,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team1 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team2 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS england_wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team1 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN team2 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total
    FROM Matches
    WHERE team1 = 'India' OR team2 = 'India'
    AND stage = 'Final'
),

T20InternationalMatches AS (
    SELECT
        'T20 International' AS context,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team1 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team2 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS england_wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team1 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN team2 = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total
    FROM Matches
    WHERE (team1 = 'India' OR team2 = 'India') 
    AND (team1 = 'England' OR team2 = 'England')
    AND stage != 'Final'
)

SELECT
    context, india_wins, england_wins, total
FROM T20WorldCupMatches
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    context, india_wins, england_wins, total

gold_sql: SELECT 'Overall T20Is' AS context, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS england_wins, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Matches m WHERE (m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India') UNION ALL SELECT 'T20 World Cups', SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner='England' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='England') OR (m.team1='England' AND m.team2='India'));

question: T20 World Cup 2026 में India के शीर्ष बल्लेबाजों का प्रदर्शन कैसा रहा?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id=m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND m.season = '2025/26' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.runs) AS hs FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id=p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY hs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('Ishan Kishan', 103)", "('SV Samson', 97)", "('SA Yadav', 84)", "('Abhishek Sharma', 84)", "('S Mandhana', 82)", "('Shafali Verma', 79)", "('Tilak Varma', 73)", "('JI Rodrigues', 69)", "('H Kaur', 68)", "('S Dube', 66)"]

    p.player_name AS player_name, 
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS hs
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id

    Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND p.player_id = d.striker_id

GROUP BY
    p.player_name

    hs DESC;

question: T20 World Cup ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ India ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਲਗਾਏ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND d.inning = 1
WHERE m.team1 = 'India' OR m.team2 = 'India'
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY p.player_name, m.season;

question: Which players have won the most Player of the Match awards in a single T20 World Cup edition?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches m JOIN Players p ON m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id WHERE m.player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.player_of_match_id, p.player_name, m.season ORDER BY potm_awards DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
   p.player_name,
   m.season,
   COUNT(m.player_of_match_id) AS potm_awards
FROM Players AS p
JOIN Matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.player_of_match_id
WHERE m.result_type = 'match'
  AND strftime('%Y', m.match_date, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') LIKE '20%'
GROUP BY
   p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY 
   potm_awards DESC;

question: What are the biggest win margins against Full Member sides in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: SELECT m.match_winner, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, m.result_type, m.result_margin, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type IN ('runs', 'wickets') AND CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END IN ( 'Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland', 'New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe' ) ORDER BY m.result_margin DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('India', 'New Zealand', 'runs', 168, '2022/23')", "('India', 'England', 'runs', 150, '2024/25')", "('England', 'South Africa', 'runs', 146, '2025')", "('Pakistan', 'West Indies', 'runs', 143, '2018')", "('India', 'Ireland', 'runs', 143, '2018')", "('England', 'West Indies', 'runs', 137, '2018/19')", "('India', 'South Africa', 'runs', 135, '2024/25')", "('Australia', 'Sri Lanka', 'runs', 134, '2019/20')", "('India', 'Bangladesh', 'runs', 133, '2024/25')", "('Australia', 'Sri Lanka', 'runs', 132, '2019/20')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT m.match_winner AS match_winner, 
       CASE 
           WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser,
       m.result_type AS result_type, 
       m.result_margin AS result_margin, 
       m.season AS season
FROM Matches m
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON m.match_id = pim1.match_id AND pim1.team_name = m.team1
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON m.match_id = pim2.match_id AND pim2.team_name = m.team2
WHERE m.result_type = 'complete'
  AND m.stage = 'World Cup' 
  AND (pim1.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE is_full_member = 1) OR pim2.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE is_full_member = 1))
ORDER BY result_margin DESC;

question: T20 World Cup 2026 లో India టాప్ బ్యాటర్లు ఎలా రాణించారు?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id=m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND m.season = '2025/26' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.runs) AS hs FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id=p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY hs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('Ishan Kishan', 103)", "('SV Samson', 97)", "('SA Yadav', 84)", "('Abhishek Sharma', 84)", "('S Mandhana', 82)", "('Shafali Verma', 79)", "('Tilak Varma', 73)", "('JI Rodrigues', 69)", "('H Kaur', 68)", "('S Dube', 66)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    MAX(d.runs_scored) AS hs
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'T20 World Cup 2026' AND
    pim.team_name = 'India' AND
    d.runs_scored > 0 AND
    d.wides = 0 AND 
    d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    hs DESC;

question: एक से अधिक T20 World Cup फाइनल हारने वाली टीमें कौन सी हैं?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS final_losses, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season, ', ') AS seasons FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY final_losses DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    team1 as loser,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner != team1 THEN match_id END) AS final_losses,
    GROUP_CONCAT(season ORDER BY season ASC) AS seasons
FROM Matches
WHERE
    stage = 'Final' AND
    toss_decision = 'Bowl'
GROUP BY
    team1
HAVING
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner != team1 THEN match_id END) > 1;

gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches_played, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = pim.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.match_id) AS win_percentage FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pim.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'South Africa', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Zimbabwe', 'Afghanistan', 'Ireland') GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(m.match_id) >= 20 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 5;
